BONUS.description: The entry quantity is the bonus paid with the month. A bonus paid three times a year or less is 賞与; a computation period over six months belongs to BONUS_OVER_SIX_MONTHS.

references.title: 健康保険法 art.3(6) and 厚生年金保険法 art.3(1)(iv): a bonus paid three times a year or less is 賞与, assessed on the standard bonus amount (健保法 art.45, 厚年法 art.24の4), not the monthly grade; wages for labour insurance; withheld by the bonus rate table (所得税法 art.186(1)(ii)). The 賞与支払届 is due within 5 days (健保則 art.27, 厚年則 art.19の5). A bonus for a period over six months is BONUS_OVER_SIX_MONTHS (所得税法 art.186(2)). Entry: quantity = the bonus amount paid with the month.

BONUS_OVER_SIX_MONTHS.description: The entry quantity is the bonus paid for a computation period over six months. It is assessed as a bonus; under the monthly-table method the period is divided by twelve rather than six.

references.title: 所得税法 art.186(2): where the bonus computation period exceeds six months and the 月額表 method applies, the bonus is divided by twelve, not six. Otherwise as BONUS: 標準賞与額 for social insurance, a wage for labour insurance. Entry: quantity = the bonus amount; the computation period is over six months.

SHUTDOWN_ALLOWANCE.description: The entry quantity is the Article 12 average-wage base for the employer-caused idle period (average daily wage multiplied by idle days). The allowance is 60% of that base; wages actually paid for the idle time reduce the base before entry.

references.title: 労働基準法26条: an employer-caused suspension requires at least60percent of the actual Article12average wage. The ordinary wages paid for the suspended time remain actual payment facts; no named average is entered. Entry: quantity = the average-wage base for the idle period; `lookup` holds the 60% rate and the average-wage source policy.

INJURY_WAITING_COMPENSATION.description: The entry quantity is the Article 12 average-wage base for the occupational-injury waiting days (average daily wage multiplied by waiting days, at most three). The employer pays 60% of that base.

references.title: 労働基準法76条 and 労災保険法14条: compensation for the actual occupational-injury waiting days uses60percent of the actual Article12average wage. The genuine event and covered dates remain original case/entry  Entry: quantity = the average-wage base for the waiting days (maximum three); `lookup` holds the 60% rate and the average-wage source policy.

DISMISSAL_NOTICE_ALLOWANCE.description: The entry quantity is the Article 12 average-wage base for the notice shortfall (average daily wage multiplied by the days of notice not given, at most thirty).

references.title: 労働基準法20条 and21条: the applicable notice shortfall is paid at the actual Article12average wage. Original notice dates and an actually applicable statutory/certified exemption remain source  Taxed as retirement income under 所得税基本通達30-5. Entry: quantity = the average-wage base for the notice shortfall (maximum thirty days); `lookup` holds the average-wage source policy.

RETIREMENT_ALLOWANCE.description: The entry quantity is the retirement allowance the work rules provide. It is paid after exit and taxed as retirement income; it is not remuneration or a labour-insurance wage.

references.title: No statute requires a retirement allowance; where the work rules provide one (労働基準法 art.89(iii)の2) it is paid as they state. Retirement income (所得税法 art.30), withheld by RETIREMENT_TAX; not remuneration for social insurance or wages for labour insurance. The resident tax on retirement income (10%) is withheld by RESIDENT_TAX_RETIREMENT. It is payable after the exit (payable_after_exit): withheld when paid (所得税法 arts.199, 203) on a slip of its own; no premium is charged on it. Entry: quantity = the retirement allowance amount.

RETIREMENT_ALLOWANCE_UNDECLARED.description: The retirement allowance of a leaver who filed no 退職所得の受給に関する申告書: withheld at 20.42% of the payment, with no deduction.

references.title: 所得税法 art.28: a cash allowance paid in the month is salary income, remuneration for social insurance (健保法 art.3(5)) and a wage for labour insurance — including any excess over the night-duty or night-meal limits. Entry: quantity = the cash allowance amount; `lookup` holds the night limits above which an amount belongs here.

NIGHT_DUTY_ALLOWANCE.description: The entry quantity is the number of 宿直・日直 occasions. The catalogue pays the non-taxable limit per occasion; any excess is entered as SPECIAL_ALLOWANCE.

references.title: 所得税基本通達 28-1: a 宿直・日直 allowance up to 4,000 yen an occasion is not taxable (entry.quantity occasions; the class pays at most that, any excess is SPECIAL_ALLOWANCE). It is 報酬 for social insurance (健康保険法 art.3(5); 日本年金機構 lists 宿日直手当 as 報酬) and a wage for labour insurance (労働保険徴収法 art.2(2)). Entry: quantity = occasions; `lookup.limit_per_unit` is the non-taxable limit per occasion.

NIGHT_MEAL_CASH.description: The entry quantity is the number of night-work meal occasions. The catalogue pays the non-taxable limit per occasion; a payment above the limit is wholly taxable and is entered as SPECIAL_ALLOWANCE.

references.title: 昭和59年7月26日 直法6-5 as amended 令和8年3月31日: cash paid instead of a meal for night work (22:00–05:00) is not taxable up to 300 yen an occasion (entry.quantity; from 1 April 2026 650, before 300). The exemption holds only where the whole payment of the occasion is within the limit; a larger payment is wholly taxable, so it is entered in full as SPECIAL_ALLOWANCE (the class refuses an amount above the limit). Enter one entry per occasion (entry.quantity 1). It is a wage: 報酬 for social insurance (健康保険法 art.3(5); 厚生年金保険法 art.3(1)(iii)) and 賃金 for labour insurance (労働保険徴収法 art.2(2)). Entry: quantity = occasions; `lookup.limit_per_unit` is the dated non-taxable limit per occasion.

DISCIPLINARY_DEDUCTION.description: The entry quantity is the Article 12 average-wage base for the disciplinary reduction (average daily wage multiplied by the deducted days). Each deduction is limited to half that base and to one tenth of the wages payable for the wage period.

references.title: 労働基準法91条: each disciplinary wage deduction is limited to half the actual daily average wage; aggregate wage-period discipline deductions are limited to one tenth of the wages payable for that wage period. Actual prior deductions remain ledger records. Entry: quantity = the average-wage base for the deducted days; `lookup` holds the half-wage and one-tenth caps and the average-wage source policy.

return Math.min(ctx.entry.quantity * ctx.lookup.rate, cap);

references.title: 労働基準法 arts.24, 32: approved overtime (every hour past the planned shift’s ordinary hours, off the statutory rest day) that stays within 8 hours a day and 40 a week (the limits OVERTIME applies) is wages at the ordinary rate, without a premium (法内残業); a monthly or daily wage covers only the scheduled hours. It is the approved overtime less the statutory part OVERTIME prices, so the two never pay the same hour. An hourly-paid worker is paid every hour by BASIC. The base is the base salary and the fixed allowances; a family allowance is left out only where it is set by the number of dependants (the FAMILY_ALLOWANCE catalog row; 昭和22年11月5日 基発231号), a commuting allowance only where it is set by the distance or the actual cost (the COMMUTING_ALLOWANCE catalog row; 昭和23年2月20日 基発297号), and a housing allowance only where it varies with the housing cost (労働基準法 art.37(5); 施行規則 art.21; 平成11年3月31日 基発170号); a flat amount paid to all is in the base.

WITHIN_HOURS_OVERTIME.description: Approved overtime past the planned shift that stays within 8 hours a day and 40 a week (法内残業): paid at the ordinary hourly rate (×1, no premium).

references.title: 労働基準法 art.37(1) with 割増賃金令: overtime beyond the statutory hours (art.32: 40 a week, 8 a day) at 125% of the hourly wage, up to 60 hours a month; 労働基準法施行規則 art.19(1)(iv): a monthly wage over the monthly average scheduled hours (the contract's monthly average scheduled hours). Every hour past the planned shift’s ordinary hours is approved overtime (work.days[].overtime_hours; work.days[].worked_hours are the paid hours, ordinary plus overtime). Off the statutory rest day it is split once: the statutory part is the paid hours beyond 8 a day, then beyond 40 a week counting each day’s hours up to 8 (44 at a 特例措置対象事業場 under 10 workers in commerce, cinema, health or hospitality, 施行規則 art.25の2; entity_extension_data.weekly_limit_44), the week starting on entity_extension_data.week_start; under a variable schedule (変形労働時間制, arts.32の2, 32の4) beyond the scheduled day and week where longer. The statutory part never exceeds the approved overtime; the rest is WITHIN_HOURS_OVERTIME at the ordinary rate, so no hour is paid twice. Under flextime (art.32の3) it is the paid hours beyond 40 a week over the month; under a discretionary or deemed regime (arts.38の2–38の4) the deemed hours beyond 8 a day (entity_extension_data.working_time_regime). A calendar week that opens before the attendance window counts its earlier days (work.week_before) toward the 40 hours, and the period pays only the excess beyond what those days alone already exceeded (昭和63年1月1日 基発1号: the week is the calendar week). Statutory rest-day hours are REST_DAY_WORK, never here. The base excludes the family, commuting and (cost-linked) housing allowances (art.37(5), 施行規則 art.21; terms.allowances[]). An hourly-paid term already has its hours in BASIC, so the line pays the premium only. The base is the base salary and the fixed allowances; a family allowance is left out only where it is set by the number of dependants (the FAMILY_ALLOWANCE catalog row; 昭和22年11月5日 基発231号), a commuting allowance only where it is set by the distance or the actual cost (the COMMUTING_ALLOWANCE catalog row; 昭和23年2月20日 基発297号), and a housing allowance only where it varies with the housing cost (労働基準法 art.37(5); 施行規則 art.21; 平成11年3月31日 基発170号); a flat amount paid to all is in the base.

OVERTIME.description: Statutory overtime (past 8 hours a day or 40 a week), the first 60 hours of the month: paid at 125% of the hourly rate.

references.title: 労働基準法 art.37(1) proviso: overtime beyond 60 hours in a month at 150%; the small-enterprise deferral (附則 art.138) ended on 1 April 2023 (働き方改革関連法, Law 71 of 2018). Same statutory hours and hourly base as OVERTIME (the statutory part of the approved overtime, rest-day hours excluded). Hours replaced by 代替休暇 (art.37(3)) lose the extra 25% (OVERTIME_SUBSTITUTED). The base is the base salary and the fixed allowances; a family allowance is left out only where it is set by the number of dependants (the FAMILY_ALLOWANCE catalog row; 昭和22年11月5日 基発231号), a commuting allowance only where it is set by the distance or the actual cost (the COMMUTING_ALLOWANCE catalog row; 昭和23年2月20日 基発297号), and a housing allowance only where it varies with the housing cost (労働基準法 art.37(5); 施行規則 art.21; 平成11年3月31日 基発170号); a flat amount paid to all is in the base.

references.title: 労働基準法 arts.35 and 37(1) with 割増賃金令: work on the statutory weekly rest day at 135% of the hourly wage for every hour worked (work.days with day_type REST — the shift definitions mark the 法定休日; a non-statutory day off is OFF and its hours are ordinary overtime). A rest day has no ordinary hours, so all its paid hours (work.days[].worked_hours) are here and none in OVERTIME or WITHIN_HOURS_OVERTIME; an hour beyond 8 on it stays at 135% (平成11年3月31日 基発168号). Same hourly base as OVERTIME; managers and supervisors (art.41(ii)) and officers are outside it. The base is the base salary and the fixed allowances; a family allowance is left out only where it is set by the number of dependants (the FAMILY_ALLOWANCE catalog row; 昭和22年11月5日 基発231号), a commuting allowance only where it is set by the distance or the actual cost (the COMMUTING_ALLOWANCE catalog row; 昭和23年2月20日 基発297号), and a housing allowance only where it varies with the housing cost (労働基準法 art.37(5); 施行規則 art.21; 平成11年3月31日 基発170号); a flat amount paid to all is in the base.

references.title: 労働基準法 art.37(4): work between 22:00 and 05:00 (the night-work rule) earns a further 25% of the hourly wage, on top of any overtime or rest-day premium (施行規則 art.20); it applies to managers and supervisors too (art.41 excludes only hours, breaks and rest days; 最高裁 平成21年12月18日). Hours are the paid intervals inside the window (hours_between over work.days[].intervals: the ordinary hours from the first arrival, then the overtime), ordinary, overtime and rest-day hours alike. Officers are not workers. The base is the base salary and the fixed allowances; a family allowance is left out only where it is set by the number of dependants (the FAMILY_ALLOWANCE catalog row; 昭和22年11月5日 基発231号), a commuting allowance only where it is set by the distance or the actual cost (the COMMUTING_ALLOWANCE catalog row; 昭和23年2月20日 基発297号), and a housing allowance only where it varies with the housing cost (労働基準法 art.37(5); 施行規則 art.21; 平成11年3月31日 基発170号); a flat amount paid to all is in the base.

references.title: Remuneration, wages and salary income; excluded from the overtime base only where it varies with the housing cost (労働基準法施行規則 art.21(iii), 平成11年3月31日 基発170号). A sub-monthly entity (SEMI_MONTHLY, TEN_DAY, WEEKLY) pays the monthly amount spread evenly over the month’s parts (period.parts), each prorated by the part’s own paid days.

references.title: 健康保険法
references.quote: 標準報酬月額 grades 1–50, 58,000–1,390,000; 標準賞与額: the bonus with fractions under 1,000 yen dropped, at most 5,730,000 in a fiscal year. Premium is the standard remuneration times the rate, borne equally; the employer deducts the employee half from wages. Premiums run for every month of insured status, with or without pay that month (arts.156, 161). The grade is fixed by 資格取得時決定 (art.42), 定時決定 (art.41, April–June remuneration) and 随時改定 (art.43, last three months). The employee half of a month is deducted from the pay of the following month; a leaver at a month end has both months deducted from the final pay (art.167(1) proviso).

HEALTH.description: Health insurance premium (with nursing care insurance from age 40): the standard monthly remuneration × the insurer's rate, shared equally by the employee and the employer (健康保険法 arts.156, 160–161).

references.title: 健康保険法
references.quote: The standard bonus amount (fractions under 1,000 dropped) up to 5,730,000 accumulated over the fiscal year from 1 April, at the month's health and nursing rate, deducted from the bonus itself.

references.title: Cap: ¥5,730,000 per fiscal year (1 April–31 March). Prior bonus paid in the same fiscal year reduces the remaining cap. The pension bonus cap is separate and applies per payment month.

HEALTH_BONUS.description: Health insurance premium on a bonus: the bonus, rounded down to 1,000 yen and up to 5,730,000 yen in a fiscal year, × the month's health and nursing rate, shared equally and deducted from the bonus (健康保険法 art.45).

references.title: 厚生年金保険法
references.quote: 18.3% of the standard monthly remuneration and the standard bonus amount (fixed from September 2017), borne equally (art.82). 標準報酬月額 grades 1–32, 88,000 (under 93,000) to 650,000 (635,000 and over) — the health grade clamped to that range (art.20). Standard bonus: the bonus with fractions under 1,000 yen dropped, at most 1,500,000 per month of payment (art.24の4). Insured person is under 70 (the loss falls on the day before the 70th birthday, art.14(5), so the month it falls in is not charged, art.19(1)). Collection follows HEALTH (art.84).

PENSION.description: Employees' pension premium: 18.3% of the standard monthly remuneration (88,000–650,000), shared equally by the employee and the employer (厚生年金保険法 arts.20, 81–82).

references.title: 厚生年金保険法
references.quote: The standard bonus amount up to 1,500,000 a payment month at 18.3%, half each, deducted from the bonus.

references.title: Cap: ¥1,500,000 per payment month. Bonuses paid in different months each get their own cap; earlier months do not reduce this month's remaining cap. Health and child-support bonuses use the separate fiscal-year cap.

PENSION_BONUS.description: Employees' pension premium on a bonus: 18.3% of the bonus, up to 1,500,000 yen in a payment month, shared equally and deducted from the bonus (厚生年金保険法 art.24-4).

references.title: 子ども・子育て支援法; 子ども・子育て支援法施行令
references.quote: Rate 3.6/1000 from April 2020: the employer alone pays 0.36% of each welfare-pension-insured employee's standard monthly remuneration and standard bonus, collected with the pension premium. Per-person amounts truncated to the yen; the notice truncates the employer total. The exempt maternity and childcare months carry no contribution (art.71(2)).

CHILD_CONTRIBUTION.description: Child and childcare contribution, paid by the employer only: 0.36% of the standard monthly remuneration and standard bonus of each employee insured for the employees' pension (子ども・子育て支援法).

references.title: 労働保険の保険料の徴収等に関する法律
references.quote: Rates per 1000 of wages paid, 令和7年度 notice: general business 5.5 worker and 9.0 employer; agriculture, forestry, fisheries and sake brewing 6.5 and 10.0; construction 6.5 and 11.0. Worker share deducted from wages: 50 sen or less drops, above 50 sen rounds up.

EI.description: Employment insurance premium on the wages paid, at the worker's and the employer's rates for the type of business; the worker's share is deducted from wages (徴収法 arts.11–12, 31).

references.title: 労働保険の保険料の徴収等に関する法律; 雇用保険法
references.locator: 徴収法11条、31条; 雇用保険法4条4項
references.quote: A bonus is a wage; the worker's share is computed on the bonus payment and deducted from it.

EI_BONUS.description: Employment insurance premium on a bonus, at the same rates as on wages; the worker's share is deducted from the bonus (徴収法 arts.11, 31).

WORKERS_ACCIDENT.description: Workers' accident compensation insurance premium, paid by the employer only: the rate for the type of business on every wage paid to every worker (徴収法 arts.11–12).

ASBESTOS_LEVY.description: General contribution for asbestos health damage relief, paid by the employer only: 0.02 per 1,000 of the wages covered by workers' accident insurance (石綿健康被害救済法 art.35).

references.title: 所得税法; 復興財源確保法
references.locator: 所得税法183条、185条、186条; 復興財源確保法28〜31条
references.quote: 令和7年分 月額表: 甲欄 when the 給与所得者の扶養控除等申告書 is filed with this employer (art.194), by the 電算機計算の特例 (財務大臣 告示 method for pay in 2025); without it the 乙欄, less 1,610 yen for each dependant on a 従たる給与 declaration; 日雇 pay on the 丙欄 (art.185(1)(iii)). A bonus goes by the 算出率の表 (別表第三) on the previous month's pay after premiums, or by the 月額表 with no such pay or a bonus over ten times it, on a sixth, or a twelfth for a period over six months (art.186). Base: the payment's taxable pay less the premiums deducted from it (art.185(1)(i)); NON_TAXABLE_PAY stays out (art.9(1)(v), 所得税基本通達 28-1). Tables apply to pay payable from 1 January (art.185).

INCOME_TAX.description: Employee income tax withheld for the pay period.

references.title: 所得税法
references.quote: At the last salary payment of the year (a pay day in December, or the exit month of a leaver who dies, leaves in December or departs abroad, or the month of a departure abroad) the employer settles the year's tax of a resident who filed the 扶養控除等申告書 and earned 20,000,000 or less. 令和7年分 tables: 給与所得控除 at least 650,000 (別表第五), 基礎控除 950,000 at 1,320,000 or less down to 580,000 by 合計所得金額. Tax: the 速算表 on the taxable income (1,000 yen down) less the housing loan credit, times 102.1%, 100 yen down; the adjustment is that annual tax less the year's withholding (a refund when negative). Computed on a December pay day and at a qualifying exit (年末調整のしかた 令和8年分 pp.5-6: departure abroad, or no further salary expected after a disability exit or with the year's pay at most the row's limit). Year figures read the balance, each scheme apart, so resident tax stays out. YEAR_END_REFUND returns an over-withholding.

YEAR_END_ADJUSTMENT.description: Year-end adjustment: at the last salary payment of the year, or when an employee leaves in the cases the law names, the year's income tax is worked out and the difference from the tax already withheld is collected or refunded (所得税法 arts.190–193).

references.title: 所得税法
references.locator: 30条（退職所得）、89条（税率）、203条（源泉徴収）
references.quote: 退職所得の金額は、退職手当等の収入金額から退職所得控除額を控除した残額の二分の一に相当する金額とする。 Service years round a part year up. references.title: 地方税法
references.locator: 50条の5（退職所得の分離課税）、328条の5（特別徴収）

RESIDENT_TAX_RETIREMENT.description: Resident tax on a retirement allowance, withheld when it is paid: municipal 6% and prefectural 4% of the same taxable retirement income as the income tax, each truncated to 100 yen (地方税法 arts.50の5, 328の5).

RESIDENT_TAX.description: Individual resident tax deducted each month from June to the following May, in the amounts the municipality's notice states; on leaving, the remaining months may be collected at once (地方税法 arts.321-3 to 321-5).

references.title: 使用者の責に帰すべき事由による休業 (労働基準法 art.26: 休業手当 60% of the 平均賃金 (art.12) per scheduled day; excluded from the 全労働日 of the annual-leave 80% test, 平成25年7月10日 基発0710第3号) The 平均賃金 leaves out the periods art.12(3) lists, their days and their wages: occupational injury absence, 産前産後休業, an employer-caused suspension (the EMPLOYER_CAUSED work event only, with the 休業手当 paid for it), 育児休業 (incl. 出生時育児休業), 介護休業 (the balance's leave and suspension days) and the probation period (terms.probation_period.to, its wages prorated by calendar days); where they cover the whole three months the wages and days of the period are used undivided (施行規則 art.3; 昭和24年4月11日 基発421号), and a worker paid by the day or hour is guaranteed 60% of the three months’ wages over the days worked (art.12(1)(i); the recorded worked days).

SOCIAL_INSURANCE_PAYMENT.name: 健康保険・厚生年金保険料の納付 (social insurance premium payment)

WITHHOLDING_TAX_PAYMENT.description: Raises the monthly withholding-tax payment obligation for the run, due by the 10th of the following month unless the semi-annual special applies.

references.title: 所得税法 art.183(1): by the 10th of the month after payment; an employer under the semi-annual special rule (art.216) pays by WITHHOLDING_TAX_SEMIANNUAL instead. The month is the month of payment (所得税法 art.183(1) "徴収の日の属する月の翌月十日"; 地方税法 art.321の5(1)): run.pay_date. A due day on a Saturday, Sunday or published holiday of the entity moves to the next working day (国税通則法 art.10(2); 地方税法 art.20の5(2); 行政機関の休日に関する法律 art.2).

RESIDENT_TAX_PAYMENT.description: Raises the monthly resident-tax special-collection payment obligation, due by the 10th of the following month unless the semi-annual special applies.

references.title: 地方税法 art.321の5(1): by the 10th of the following month; an employer under the semi-annual special rule (art.321の5の2) pays by RESIDENT_TAX_SEMIANNUAL instead. The month is the month of payment (所得税法 art.183(1) "徴収の日の属する月の翌月十日"; 地方税法 art.321の5(1)): run.pay_date. A due day on a Saturday, Sunday or published holiday of the entity moves to the next working day (国税通則法 art.10(2); 地方税法 art.20の5(2); 行政機関の休日に関する法律 art.2).

references.title: 所得税法 art.216: an office paying fewer than 10 employees (常時十人未満) approved by the tax office (entity_extension_data.withholding_semiannual_special) pays January–June withholding by the 10th of the month after June and July–December by 20 January (NTA タックスアンサー No.2505 https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/gensen/2505.htm). RESIDENT_TAX_SEMIANNUAL.name: 住民税特別徴収の納期の特例による納入 (semi-annual resident tax payment)
RESIDENT_TAX_SEMIANNUAL.description: Raises the semi-annual resident-tax special-collection payment obligation for May and November under the mayor's special approval.

references.title: 地方税法 art.321の5の2(1): an office paying fewer than 10 employees (常時十人未満) approved by the mayor (entity_extension_data.resident_tax_semiannual_special) pays the June–November and December–May collections by the 10th of the month after each period. A due day on a Saturday, Sunday or published holiday of the entity moves to the next working day (国税通則法 art.10(2); 地方税法 art.20の5(2); 行政機関の休日に関する法律 art.2); the year-end closure (29 December–3 January) moves it only when the entity publishes those days. references.title: 地方税法 arts.50の5, 328の5(2): by the 10th of the month after the payment. A due day on a Saturday, Sunday or published holiday of the entity moves to the next working day (国税通則法 art.10(2); 地方税法 art.20の5(2); 行政機関の休日に関する法律 art.2).

WAGE_LEDGER.name: 賃金台帳の記入 (wage ledger entry)

SANTEI_KISO_REPORT.name: 算定基礎届 (standard remuneration annual report)

references.title: 健康保険法 art.41 with 健康保険法施行規則 art.25 and 厚生年金保険法 art.21 with 施行規則 art.18: between 1 and 10 July. WITHHOLDING_SLIPS_TO_EMPLOYEES.name: 源泉徴収票の交付 (withholding slips to employees)

STATUTORY_RETURNS_SUMMARY.name: 法定調書合計表の提出 (statutory returns to the tax office)
