SOCIAL_INSURANCE_ACQUISITION.name: 健康保険・厚生年金保険 被保険者資格取得届 (social insurance enrolment)
SOCIAL_INSURANCE_ACQUISITION.description: Raises the social-insurance enrolment notification for a sealed contract.

references.title: 健康保険法 art.48 with 施行規則 art.24 and 厚生年金保険法 art.27 with 施行規則 art.15: "当該事実があった日から五日以内" of the acquisition (the hire day); the due day counts the hire day itself (the earliest reading; a 民法 art.140 count would allow one day more). A due day on a Saturday, Sunday or published holiday of the entity moves to the next working day (国税通則法 art.10(2); 地方税法 art.20の5(2); 行政機関の休日に関する法律 art.2); the year-end closure (29 December–3 January) moves it only when the entity publishes those days.

EMPLOYMENT_INSURANCE_ACQUISITION.name: 雇用保険 被保険者資格取得届 (employment insurance enrolment)
EMPLOYMENT_INSURANCE_ACQUISITION.description: Raises the employment-insurance enrolment notification for a sealed contract.

references.title: 雇用保険法 art.7 with 雇用保険法施行規則 art.6(1): by the 10th of the month after the month the person became insured. A due day on a Saturday, Sunday or published holiday of the entity moves to the next working day (国税通則法 art.10(2); 地方税法 art.20の5(2); 行政機関の休日に関する法律 art.2); the year-end closure (29 December–3 January) moves it only when the entity publishes those days.

WORKING_CONDITIONS_NOTICE.name: 労働条件通知書の明示 (written working conditions)
WORKING_CONDITIONS_NOTICE.description: Raises the obligation to give the written working-conditions notice when the contract is sealed.

references.title: 労働基準法 art.15(1) with 施行規則 art.5 (as amended from 1 April 2024): at the conclusion of the contract.

WORKER_REGISTER.name: 労働者名簿の調製 (worker register)
WORKER_REGISTER.description: Raises the obligation to enter the worker in the worker register.

references.title: 労働基準法 art.107 with 施行規則 art.53: without delay; kept 5 years (3 for now) from the exit (art.109, 附則 art.143).

SOCIAL_INSURANCE_LOSS.name: 健康保険・厚生年金保険 被保険者資格喪失届 (social insurance exit)
SOCIAL_INSURANCE_LOSS.description: Raises the social-insurance loss notification on exit.

references.title: 健康保険法 art.48 with 施行規則 art.29 and 厚生年金保険法 art.27 with 施行規則 art.22: within 5 days of the loss counting the loss day (the earliest reading), which is the day after the last day of employment (健保法 art.36(ii), 厚年法 art.14(ii)). A due day on a Saturday, Sunday or published holiday of the entity moves to the next working day (国税通則法 art.10(2); 地方税法 art.20の5(2); 行政機関の休日に関する法律 art.2); the year-end closure (29 December–3 January) moves it only when the entity publishes those days.

EMPLOYMENT_INSURANCE_LOSS.name: 雇用保険 被保険者資格喪失届・離職証明書 (employment insurance exit and separation slip)
EMPLOYMENT_INSURANCE_LOSS.description: Raises the employment-insurance loss and separation-slip notification on exit.

references.title: 雇用保険法 art.7 with 雇用保険法施行規則 art.7(1)–(2): within 10 days counted from the day after the loss day (the day after the last day of employment); art.17 (離職票 delivered to the leaver). A due day on a Saturday, Sunday or published holiday of the entity moves to the next working day (国税通則法 art.10(2); 地方税法 art.20の5(2); 行政機関の休日に関する法律 art.2); the year-end closure (29 December–3 January) moves it only when the entity publishes those days.

RESIDENT_TAX_TRANSFER.name: 給与所得者異動届出書 (resident tax special collection change)
RESIDENT_TAX_TRANSFER.description: Raises the resident-tax special-collection change notification on exit.

references.title: 地方税法 art.321の7(1) and art.321の5(2): by the 10th of the month after the exit. A due day on a Saturday, Sunday or published holiday of the entity moves to the next working day (国税通則法 art.10(2); 地方税法 art.20の5(2); 行政機関の休日に関する法律 art.2); the year-end closure (29 December–3 January) moves it only when the entity publishes those days.

LEAVER_WITHHOLDING_SLIP.name: 退職者の源泉徴収票の交付 (leaver's withholding slip)
LEAVER_WITHHOLDING_SLIP.description: Raises the obligation to deliver the leaver's withholding slip within one month of exit.

references.title: 所得税法 art.226(1)–(2): the 源泉徴収票 (and the 退職所得の源泉徴収票) within one month after the exit.

FINAL_WAGES_ON_REQUEST.name: 退職時の賃金の支払・金品の返還 (final wages on request)
FINAL_WAGES_ON_REQUEST.description: Raises the obligation to pay final wages and return property within seven days of a leaver's request.

references.title: 労働基準法 art.23(1) (7 days after the request; the due day assumes a request on the last day) and art.22.

DISABILITY_EMPLOYMENT_REPORT.name: 障害者雇用状況報告 (disability employment status report)
DISABILITY_EMPLOYMENT_REPORT.description: Raises the annual disability-employment report for a bound employer in the June run.

references.title: 障害者の雇用の促進等に関する法律 art.43(7) with 施行規則 art.8: by 15 July, an employer bound by the employment quota — 40.0 or more regular employees at the statutory rate of 2.5% (from 1 April 2024) (施行令 art.9 as amended by 令和5年政令第44号; entity_extension_data.regular_employee_count, else the employments in force). A due day on a Saturday, Sunday or published holiday of the entity moves to the next working day (国税通則法 art.10(2); 地方税法 art.20の5(2); 行政機関の休日に関する法律 art.2); the year-end closure (29 December–3 January) moves it only when the entity publishes those days.

ELDERLY_EMPLOYMENT_REPORT.name: 高年齢者雇用状況等報告 (older workers employment report)
ELDERLY_EMPLOYMENT_REPORT.description: Raises the annual older-worker employment report in the June run.

references.title: 高年齢者等の雇用の安定等に関する法律 art.52(1): every employer reports once a year; 施行規則 art.33: the 1 June status by the 15th of the next month (15 July). The 21-employee figure is the ministry's survey scope, not the statute. A due day on a Saturday, Sunday or published holiday of the entity moves to the next working day (国税通則法 art.10(2); 地方税法 art.20の5(2); 行政機関の休日に関する法律 art.2); the year-end closure (29 December–3 January) moves it only when the entity publishes those days.

DISABILITY_LEVY_DECLARATION.name: 障害者雇用納付金申告 (disability employment levy declaration)
DISABILITY_LEVY_DECLARATION.description: Raises the disability-employment levy declaration for an employer over the levy threshold in the May run.

references.title: 障害者の雇用の促進等に関する法律 arts.53, 56(1) with 施行規則 art.18: an employer of more than 100 (101 or more) regular employees (附則 art.4; entity_extension_data.regular_employee_count, else the employments in force). A due day on a Saturday, Sunday or published holiday of the entity moves to the next working day (国税通則法 art.10(2); 地方税法 art.20の5(2); 行政機関の休日に関する法律 art.2); the year-end closure (29 December–3 January) moves it only when the entity publishes those days.

SOCIAL_INSURANCE_NEW_ESTABLISHMENT.name: 新規適用届 (social insurance establishment notification)
SOCIAL_INSURANCE_NEW_ESTABLISHMENT.description: Raises the social-insurance establishment notification when a sealed entity records its applicability date.

references.title: 健康保険法施行規則 art.19 and 厚生年金保険法施行規則 art.13: file the 新規適用届 within five days of the office first becoming applicable; applicability is determined by 健康保険法 art.3(3) and 厚生年金保険法 art.6. Administrative holiday extension uses the published national calendar and the statutory 29 December–3 January closure, independently of employer holidays.

LABOUR_INSURANCE_ESTABLISHMENT.name: 保険関係成立届 (labour insurance relationship notification)
LABOUR_INSURANCE_ESTABLISHMENT.description: Raises the labour-insurance relationship notification when a sealed entity records its establishment date.

references.title: 労働保険徴収法 arts.3, 4 and 4の2: the labour-insurance relationship arises on the day the business starts and the 保険関係成立届 is due within ten days. Administrative holiday extension uses the published national calendar and the statutory 29 December–3 January closure, independently of employer holidays.

LABOUR_INSURANCE_PROVISIONAL_DECLARATION.name: 概算保険料申告 (provisional labour insurance premium declaration)
LABOUR_INSURANCE_PROVISIONAL_DECLARATION.description: Raises the provisional labour-insurance premium declaration when a sealed entity records its establishment date.

references.title: 労働保険徴収法 art.15: the provisional premium declaration is due within fifty days of the labour-insurance relationship arising. Administrative holiday extension uses the published national calendar and the statutory 29 December–3 January closure, independently of employer holidays.

EMPLOYMENT_INSURANCE_ESTABLISHMENT.name: 雇用保険適用事業所設置届 (employment insurance establishment notification)
EMPLOYMENT_INSURANCE_ESTABLISHMENT.description: Raises the employment-insurance establishment notification when a sealed entity records its establishment date.

references.title: 雇用保険法施行規則 art.141: file the 雇用保険適用事業所設置届 within ten days counted from the day after the office is set up; 雇用保険法 art.5 defines the applicable business. Administrative holiday extension uses the published national calendar and the statutory 29 December–3 January closure, independently of employer holidays.

PAYROLL_OFFICE_OPENING.name: 給与支払事務所等の開設届出書 (payroll office opening notification)
PAYROLL_OFFICE_OPENING.description: Raises the salary-payment office opening notification when a sealed entity records its opening date.

references.title: 所得税法 art.230: file the 給与支払事務所等の開設届出書 within one month of opening the salary-payment office. Administrative holiday extension uses the published national calendar and the statutory 29 December–3 January closure, independently of employer holidays.

BONUS_PAYMENT_REPORT.name: 賞与支払届 (bonus payment report)
BONUS_PAYMENT_REPORT.description: Raises the bonus payment report when a bonus entry is created.

references.title: 健康保険法 art.48 with 施行規則 art.27 and 厚生年金保険法 art.27 with 施行規則 art.19の5: "賞与を支払った日から五日以内" — raised when a payslip carrying a BONUS line is paid (the bonus entry's incurred date); the due day counts the payment day (the earliest reading). A due day on a Saturday, Sunday or published holiday of the entity moves to the next working day (行政機関の休日に関する法律 art.2).

MATERNITY_PREMIUM_EXEMPTION.name: 産前産後休業取得者申出書 (maternity premium exemption application)
MATERNITY_PREMIUM_EXEMPTION.description: Raises the maternity premium-exemption application when prenatal or postnatal leave is entered.

references.title: 健康保険法 art.159の3 and 厚生年金保険法 art.81の2の2 with 健康保険法施行規則 art.135の2: the employer applies while the leave lasts (the leave's last day is the due day shown; 日本年金機構 guidance). A due day on a Saturday, Sunday or published holiday of the entity moves to the next working day (行政機関の休日に関する法律 art.2).

CHILDCARE_PREMIUM_EXEMPTION.name: 育児休業等取得者申出書 (childcare premium exemption application)
CHILDCARE_PREMIUM_EXEMPTION.description: Raises the childcare premium-exemption application when childcare or postnatal paternity leave is entered.

references.title: 健康保険法 art.159 and 厚生年金保険法 art.81の2 with 健康保険法施行規則 art.135: the employer applies while the leave lasts (the leave's last day is the due day shown). A month is exempt when the leave includes its last day, or lasts 14 days or more within it; a bonus month only for a leave of more than one month. A due day on a Saturday, Sunday or published holiday of the entity moves to the next working day (行政機関の休日に関する法律 art.2).

WORK_INJURY_REPORT.name: 労働者死傷病報告 (work-injury report, 4 days or more)
WORK_INJURY_REPORT.description: Raises the work-injury report when an occupational-injury absence reaches four days.
WORK_INJURY_REPORT.condition:
if (!["OCCUPATIONAL_INJURY_ABSENCE"].includes(ctx.entry.catalog_code)) return false;
return ctx.reads.leave_catalog_entry_day.length >= 2 * ctx.lookup.report_days_threshold;

references.title: 労働安全衛生法 art.100 with 労働安全衛生規則 art.97(1): "遅滞なく" for a death or an absence of 4 days or more (electronic filing from 1 January 2025); the 4th day of absence is the due day shown. A due day on a Saturday, Sunday or published holiday of the entity moves to the next working day (行政機関の休日に関する法律 art.2).

WORK_INJURY_REPORT_QUARTERLY.name: 労働者死傷病報告 (work-injury report, under 4 days)
WORK_INJURY_REPORT_QUARTERLY.description: Raises the quarterly work-injury report for an occupational-injury absence under four days.
WORK_INJURY_REPORT_QUARTERLY.condition:
if (!["OCCUPATIONAL_INJURY_ABSENCE"].includes(ctx.entry.catalog_code)) return false;
return ctx.reads.leave_catalog_entry_day.length < 2 * ctx.lookup.report_days_threshold;

references.title: 労働安全衛生規則 art.97(2): absences under 4 days of January–March, April–June, July–September and October–December by the end of the month after each quarter. A due day on a Saturday, Sunday or published holiday of the entity moves to the next working day (行政機関の休日に関する法律 art.2).

WOMEN_ADVANCEMENT_PUBLICATION.name: 女性の活躍に関する情報公表 (women's advancement information publication)
WOMEN_ADVANCEMENT_PUBLICATION.description: Raises the annual women's-advancement information publication for a large employer.

references.title: 女性の職業生活における活躍の推進に関する法律 art.20 (as amended, from 1 April 2026: the gender wage gap and the female manager ratio for an employer of 101 or more, previously the wage gap for 301 or more) with 一般事業主行動計画等に関する省令 art.19(4) ("おおむね一年に一回以上"); the ministry's notice places it within about three months of the business-year end. Headcount is the entity's employments in force; the business-year end month is the effect's business_year_end_month. A due day on a Saturday, Sunday or published holiday of the entity moves to the next working day (行政機関の休日に関する法律 art.2).

ANNUAL_LEAVE_FIVE_DAY_DESIGNATION.name: 年次有給休暇の時季指定 (5-day designated annual leave)
ANNUAL_LEAVE_FIVE_DAY_DESIGNATION.description: Raises the obligation to designate five days of annual leave on each grant day.

references.title: 労働基準法 art.39(7)–(8) with 施行規則 arts.24の5–24の7; art.120 (penalty). Raised on each grant day — 6 months after hire and every year after (the 六箇月経過日 and its anniversaries) — except for a short-week worker granted fewer than 10 days (施行規則 art.24の3: 4 days a week from 3½ years, 3 days a week from 5½ years reach 10). A grant the 80% attendance test refused (or below 10 days) raises nothing: the calendar row’s leave_balances carry the ANNUAL_LEAVE entitlement granted that day.
references.locator: 第39条第7項・第8項、労働基準法施行規則第24条の5～第24条の7

OVERTIME_AGREEMENT_RENEWAL.name: 36協定の締結・届出 (overtime agreement renewal and filing)
OVERTIME_AGREEMENT_RENEWAL.description: Raises the 36-agreement renewal and filing obligation in the run before the agreement expires.

references.title: 労働基準法 art.36(1) with 施行規則 art.16–17: the agreement takes effect only once filed; its period is at most one year in practice (the yearly limit is set per year). Customer input: entity_extension_data.overtime_agreement_to. Raised in the run of the month before the expiry month.

LABOUR_INSURANCE_INSTALMENT_2.name: 労働保険料 延納 第2期 (labour insurance instalment 2)
LABOUR_INSURANCE_INSTALMENT_2.description: Raises the second labour-insurance instalment for an employer paying by instalments in the October run.

references.title: 労働保険の保険料の徴収等に関する法律 art.18 with 施行規則 arts.27–28: an employer whose provisional premium is 400,000 or more (or entrusted to a labour insurance association) may pay in three instalments — 10 July, 31 October and 31 January (14 November and 14 February for a member of a 労働保険事務組合, 施行規則 art.28(2); entity_extension_data.labour_insurance_association); customer input: entity_extension_data.labour_insurance_instalments. A due day on a Saturday, Sunday or published holiday of the entity moves to the next working day (国税通則法 art.10(2) applied by 徴収法 art.41).

LABOUR_INSURANCE_INSTALMENT_3.name: 労働保険料 延納 第3期 (labour insurance instalment 3)
LABOUR_INSURANCE_INSTALMENT_3.description: Raises the third labour-insurance instalment for an employer paying by instalments in the January run.

references.title: 労働保険の保険料の徴収等に関する法律 art.18 with 施行規則 arts.27–28: an employer whose provisional premium is 400,000 or more (or entrusted to a labour insurance association) may pay in three instalments — 10 July, 31 October and 31 January (14 November and 14 February for a member of a 労働保険事務組合, 施行規則 art.28(2); entity_extension_data.labour_insurance_association); customer input: entity_extension_data.labour_insurance_instalments. A due day on a Saturday, Sunday or published holiday of the entity moves to the next working day (国税通則法 art.10(2) applied by 徴収法 art.41).

HEALTH_LOSS_AT_75.name: 健康保険 資格喪失届（75歳到達） (health insurance loss at 75)
HEALTH_LOSS_AT_75.description: Raises the health-insurance loss notification on the worker's 75th birthday.

references.title: 高齢者の医療の確保に関する法律 arts.50, 52 and 健康保険法 art.36(iii) with 施行規則 art.29: "当該事実があった日から五日以内" (the birthday counts). A due day on a Saturday, Sunday or published holiday of the entity moves to the next working day (国税通則法 art.10(2); 地方税法 art.20の5(2); 行政機関の休日に関する法律 art.2).

PENSION_AGE_70.name: 厚生年金 70歳到達届・70歳以上被用者該当届 (pension loss at 70)
PENSION_AGE_70.description: Raises the pension loss and age-70 notification on the worker's 70th birthday.

references.title: 厚生年金保険法 arts.14(v), 27 with 施行規則 arts.15の2, 22: within 5 days of the day before the 70th birthday (年齢計算ニ関スル法律). A due day on a Saturday, Sunday or published holiday of the entity moves to the next working day (国税通則法 art.10(2); 地方税法 art.20の5(2); 行政機関の休日に関する法律 art.2).

MATERNITY_END_GRADE_CHANGE.name: 産前産後休業終了時報酬月額変更届 (grade change after maternity leave)
MATERNITY_END_GRADE_CHANGE.description: Raises the standard-remuneration grade-change report after postnatal leave.

references.title: 健康保険法 art.43の3 and 厚生年金保険法 art.23の3 with 健保則 art.26の3: "速やかに" after the three months' pay is known (the 10th of the following month is the due day shown). A due day on a Saturday, Sunday or published holiday of the entity moves to the next working day (国税通則法 art.10(2); 地方税法 art.20の5(2); 行政機関の休日に関する法律 art.2).

CHILDCARE_END_GRADE_CHANGE.name: 育児休業等終了時報酬月額変更届・養育期間特例申出 (grade change after childcare leave)
CHILDCARE_END_GRADE_CHANGE.description: Raises the standard-remuneration grade-change report after childcare leave.

references.title: 健康保険法 art.43の2, 厚生年金保険法 arts.23の2, 26 with 健保則 art.26の2 and 厚年則 art.10の2の2: "速やかに" (the 10th after the three months is shown). A due day on a Saturday, Sunday or published holiday of the entity moves to the next working day (国税通則法 art.10(2); 地方税法 art.20の5(2); 行政機関の休日に関する法律 art.2).

CHILDCARE_BENEFIT_APPLICATION.name: 育児休業給付金・出生後休業支援給付金 初回申請 (childcare leave benefit, first application)
CHILDCARE_BENEFIT_APPLICATION.description: Raises the first childcare-leave benefit application when childcare leave is entered.

references.title: 雇用保険法 arts.61の7, 61の10 with 雇用保険法施行規則 arts.101の30, 101の42: by the end of the month of the day four months after the first unit period begins (the leave's first day). A due day on a Saturday, Sunday or published holiday of the entity moves to the next working day (国税通則法 art.10(2); 地方税法 art.20の5(2); 行政機関の休日に関する法律 art.2). An extension entered as a new row continues the leave and raises no second first application.

CARE_LEAVE_BENEFIT_APPLICATION.name: 介護休業給付金 申請 (family care leave benefit)
CARE_LEAVE_BENEFIT_APPLICATION.description: Raises the family-care leave benefit application when family-care leave is entered.

references.title: 雇用保険法 art.61の4 with 施行規則 art.101の19: by the end of the month of the day two months after the day after the leave ends. A due day on a Saturday, Sunday or published holiday of the entity moves to the next working day (国税通則法 art.10(2); 地方税法 art.20の5(2); 行政機関の休日に関する法律 art.2). An extension entered as a new row continues the leave and raises no second first application.

OLDER_WORKER_CONTINUATION_BENEFIT.name: 高年齢雇用継続給付 受給資格確認・60歳到達時賃金証明書 (older worker continuation benefit)
OLDER_WORKER_CONTINUATION_BENEFIT.description: Raises the older-worker continuation benefit application when the contract records the election.

references.title: 雇用保険法 art.61 with 施行規則 art.101の5: the first application within four months from the first day of the first qualifying month (the month after reaching 60 is shown). A due day on a Saturday, Sunday or published holiday of the entity moves to the next working day (国税通則法 art.10(2); 地方税法 art.20の5(2); 行政機関の休日に関する法律 art.2).

SHORT_HOURS_CHILDCARE_BENEFIT.name: 育児時短就業給付金 初回申請 (shortened-hours childcare benefit)
SHORT_HOURS_CHILDCARE_BENEFIT.description: Raises the shortened-hours childcare benefit application when the contract records the election.

references.title: 雇用保険法 arts.61の12–61の13 with 施行規則 art.101の48: within four months from the first day of the first qualifying month. A due day on a Saturday, Sunday or published holiday of the entity moves to the next working day (国税通則法 art.10(2); 地方税法 art.20の5(2); 行政機関の休日に関する法律 art.2).

RETIREMENT_INCOME_SLIP.name: 退職所得の源泉徴収票・特別徴収票 (retirement income slip)
RETIREMENT_INCOME_SLIP.description: Raises the retirement-income withholding slip when a retirement allowance entry is created.

references.title: 所得税法 arts.203, 226(2) and 地方税法 art.50の9: within one month after the retirement (所得税法施行規則 art.77). A due day on a Saturday, Sunday or published holiday of the entity moves to the next working day (国税通則法 art.10(2); 地方税法 art.20の5(2); 行政機関の休日に関する法律 art.2).

PAYSLIP_DELIVERY.name: 給与支払明細書の交付 (pay statement delivery)
PAYSLIP_DELIVERY.description: Raises the obligation to deliver the pay statement for the run.

references.title: 所得税法 art.231 with 施行規則 art.100: at the payment; electronic delivery needs the employee's consent (art.231(2)).

STATUTORY_RETURNS_E_FILING.name: 法定調書の電子提出義務 (mandatory e-filing of statutory returns)
STATUTORY_RETURNS_E_FILING.description: Raises the mandatory e-filing reminder for an employer over the statutory-return threshold in the January run.

references.title: 所得税法 art.228の4 and 地方税法 art.317の6(5): 100 or more (30 from 1 January 2027); customer input: entity_extension_data.statutory_return_count_two_years_prior. A due day on a Saturday, Sunday or published holiday of the entity moves to the next working day (国税通則法 art.10(2); 地方税法 art.20の5(2); 行政機関の休日に関する法律 art.2).

RESIDENT_TAX_SPECIAL_COLLECTION_SWITCH.name: 特別徴収への切替届出 (switch of resident tax to special collection)
RESIDENT_TAX_SPECIAL_COLLECTION_SWITCH.description: Raises the resident-tax special-collection switch notification when the contract records the employee's request.

references.title: 地方税法 art.321の4(1)–(2): on the employee's request (employee_extension_data.resident_tax_special_collection_switch); the end of the hire month is the due day shown. A due day on a Saturday, Sunday or published holiday of the entity moves to the next working day (国税通則法 art.10(2); 地方税法 art.20の5(2); 行政機関の休日に関する法律 art.2).

WORK_RULES_FILING.name: 就業規則の作成・届出 (work rules filing)
WORK_RULES_FILING.description: Raises the work-rules filing reminder for an employer at or above ten workers with no filing date recorded.

references.title: 労働基準法 arts.89–90: an employer regularly employing 10 or more workers (headcount). A due day on a Saturday, Sunday or published holiday of the entity moves to the next working day (国税通則法 art.10(2); 地方税法 art.20の5(2); 行政機関の休日に関する法律 art.2).

NON_RENEWAL_NOTICE.name: 雇止めの予告 (notice of non-renewal)
NON_RENEWAL_NOTICE.description: Raises the non-renewal notice obligation before a fixed-term contract ends.

references.title: 有期労働契約の締結、更新及び雇止めに関する基準 (平成15年厚生労働省告示357号) arts.1–2 with 労働基準法 art.14(2) (renewal_count; service over a year).

INDEFINITE_CONVERSION_NOTICE.name: 無期転換申込権の明示 (indefinite conversion right)
INDEFINITE_CONVERSION_NOTICE.description: Raises the indefinite-conversion notice on the five-year anniversary of a fixed-term contract.

references.title: 労働契約法 art.18 and 労働基準法施行規則 art.5(5)–(6): the right arises where the total of fixed terms exceeds five years; the five-year day of this employment is shown (earlier fixed terms without a six-month gap also count).

PART_TIME_TERMS_NOTICE.name: 短時間・有期雇用労働者への特定事項の明示 (written specified terms for part-time and fixed-term workers)
PART_TIME_TERMS_NOTICE.description: Raises the written specified-terms notice for a part-time or fixed-term employee.

references.title: 短時間労働者及び有期雇用労働者の雇用管理の改善等に関する法律 arts.6(1), 14(1) with 施行規則 art.2

ANNUAL_LEAVE_REGISTER.name: 年次有給休暇管理簿 (annual leave register)
ANNUAL_LEAVE_REGISTER.description: Raises the obligation to record the annual-leave grant in the leave register.

references.title: 労働基準法施行規則 arts.24の7, 72 and 労働基準法 art.109, 附則 art.143: on each grant day. Only a grant made (the leave_balances entitlement): a grant refused for attendance has nothing to record.
references.locator: 労働基準法施行規則第24条の7

ANNUAL_LEAVE_ATTENDANCE_REVIEW.name: 年次有給休暇の出勤率確認 (annual leave attendance review)
ANNUAL_LEAVE_ATTENDANCE_REVIEW.description: Raises an attendance-rate review before an annual-leave grant day.

lookup.message: Recorded attendance before this annual leave grant day is below the statutory ratio. Confirm it, and where it stands record ATTENDANCE_BELOW_RATIO on the grant day (労働基準法 art.39(1)–(2)).

references.title: 労働基準法 art.39(1)–(2), (10): 80% of the working days of the six months or the year before the grant day. Work-injury, childcare, family care and maternity leave and annual leave taken count as attended (昭22.9.13 発基17). Days the employer closed, 代替休暇 and lawful strike days leave the working days (平25.7.10 基発0710第3号).

MY_NUMBER_COLLECTION.name: 個人番号の提供の求め (My Number collection)
MY_NUMBER_COLLECTION.description: Raises the obligation to request the employee's My Number when the contract is sealed.

references.title: 行政手続における特定の個人を識別するための番号の利用等に関する法律 arts.14(1), 16, 19(i): the employer as 個人番号関係事務実施者.

SEPARATION_CERTIFICATE.name: 退職証明書 (certificate of employment on leaving)
SEPARATION_CERTIFICATE.description: Raises the certificate-of-employment obligation on an employee's request.

references.title: Labour Standards Act art.22(1),(3): issue without delay on an actual employee request and state only the requested particulars. Due on request receipt, or actual departure if requested beforehand.

MALE_CHILDCARE_LEAVE_PUBLICATION.name: 男性の育児休業等取得状況の公表 (publication of men's childcare leave)
MALE_CHILDCARE_LEAVE_PUBLICATION.description: Raises the annual publication of men's childcare-leave uptake for a large employer.

references.title: 育児・介護休業法 art.22の2 with 施行規則 arts.71の3–71の4: an employer regularly employing more than 300 from April 2025 (1,000 before), once a year for the previous business year (within about three months of its end per the ministry; the effect's business_year_end_month). A due day on a Saturday, Sunday or published holiday of the entity moves to the next working day (国税通則法 art.10(2); 地方税法 art.20の5(2); 行政機関の休日に関する法律 art.2).

NEXT_GENERATION_ACTION_PLAN.name: 次世代法 一般事業主行動計画の策定・届出 (next-generation action plan)
NEXT_GENERATION_ACTION_PLAN.description: Raises the next-generation action-plan filing reminder for an employer over the threshold.

references.title: 次世代育成支援対策推進法 arts.12, 12の2 (as amended 2024): an employer regularly employing more than 100 ("遅滞なく"). A due day on a Saturday, Sunday or published holiday of the entity moves to the next working day (国税通則法 art.10(2); 地方税法 art.20の5(2); 行政機関の休日に関する法律 art.2).

WOMEN_ACTION_PLAN.name: 女性活躍推進法 一般事業主行動計画の策定・届出 (women's advancement action plan)
WOMEN_ACTION_PLAN.description: Raises the women's-advancement action-plan filing reminder for an employer over the threshold.

references.title: 女性の職業生活における活躍の推進に関する法律 art.8: an employer regularly employing more than 100. A due day on a Saturday, Sunday or published holiday of the entity moves to the next working day (国税通則法 art.10(2); 地方税法 art.20の5(2); 行政機関の休日に関する法律 art.2).

MID_CAREER_HIRING_PUBLICATION.name: 中途採用比率の公表 (publication of the mid-career hiring ratio)
MID_CAREER_HIRING_PUBLICATION.description: Raises the annual mid-career hiring-ratio publication for a large employer.

references.title: 労働施策の総合的な推進並びに労働者の雇用の安定及び職業生活の充実等に関する法律 art.27の2 with 施行規則 art.9の2: an employer regularly employing more than 300, about once a year. A due day on a Saturday, Sunday or published holiday of the entity moves to the next working day (国税通則法 art.10(2); 地方税法 art.20の5(2); 行政機関の休日に関する法律 art.2).

CARE_INFORMATION_AT_40.name: 介護休業制度等の情報提供（40歳） (care leave information at 40)
CARE_INFORMATION_AT_40.description: Raises the care-leave information notice in the year the worker turns 40.

references.title: 育児・介護休業法 art.21(3) with 施行規則 art.69の8: in the business year (1 April–31 March) in which the worker reaches 40, or the year after; the end of that business year is shown.

CARE_INDIVIDUAL_NOTICE.name: 介護に直面した労働者への個別周知・意向確認 (individual notice to a worker facing care)
CARE_INDIVIDUAL_NOTICE.description: Raises the individual care notice when family-care leave or care days are entered.

references.title: 育児・介護休業法 art.21(2) with 施行規則 art.69の4 (from 1 April 2025): on the worker's report of a family member needing care.

RECORDS_RETENTION.name: 労働関係書類の保存 (retention of employment records)
RECORDS_RETENTION.description: Raises the employment-records retention reminder on exit.

references.title: 労働基準法 art.109 with 施行規則 art.56 and 附則 art.143(1) (three years for now); 所得税法施行規則 arts.76の3, 77 (扶養控除等申告書 etc., seven years); 健康保険法施行規則 art.34 and 厚年則 art.28 (two years); 雇用保険法施行規則 art.143 (four years for 被保険者 records).

CHILDCARE_ENVIRONMENT_MEASURES.name: 育児休業等を取得しやすい雇用環境の整備 (childcare leave environment measures)
CHILDCARE_ENVIRONMENT_MEASURES.description: Raises the childcare-leave environment measures reminder when an entity version is sealed.

references.title: 育児・介護休業法 arts.21(1), 22(1) with 施行規則 art.71の2 (every employer from April 2022; care leave measures from April 2025, art.22(4)).

HARASSMENT_PREVENTION_MEASURES.name: ハラスメント防止措置 (harassment prevention measures)
HARASSMENT_PREVENTION_MEASURES.description: Raises the harassment-prevention measures reminder when an entity version is sealed.

references.title: 労働施策の総合的な推進並びに労働者の雇用の安定及び職業生活の充実等に関する法律 art.30の2 (every employer from April 2022), 男女雇用機会均等法 arts.11, 11の3 and 育児・介護休業法 art.25, with the ministry's 指針.

HEALTH_CHECK_AT_HIRE.name: 雇入時の健康診断 (health check at hire)
HEALTH_CHECK_AT_HIRE.description: Raises the health check at hire when a contract is sealed.

references.title: 労働安全衛生法 art.66(1) with 労働安全衛生規則 arts.43, 51: on hiring a worker employed regularly (a short-time worker of three quarters or more of the full-time hours; 平成19年10月1日 基発1001016号).

PERIODIC_HEALTH_CHECK.name: 定期健康診断 (annual health check)
PERIODIC_HEALTH_CHECK.description: Raises the annual periodic health check on the hire anniversary.

references.title: 労働安全衛生法 art.66(1) with 労働安全衛生規則 arts.44, 51: "一年以内ごとに一回、定期に"; raised on each anniversary of the hire for a regularly employed worker.

HEALTH_CHECK_REPORT.name: 定期健康診断結果報告書 (health check result report)
HEALTH_CHECK_REPORT.description: Raises the annual health-check result report for an employer at or above the threshold.

references.title: 労働安全衛生規則 art.52: an employer regularly employing 50 or more, "遅滞なく" (the month end is shown). A due day on a Saturday, Sunday or published holiday of the entity moves to the next working day (国税通則法 art.10(2); 地方税法 art.20の5(2); 行政機関の休日に関する法律 art.2).

STRESS_CHECK.name: ストレスチェックの実施・報告 (stress check and report)
STRESS_CHECK.description: Raises the annual stress-check and report obligation for an employer at or above the threshold.

references.title: 労働安全衛生法 art.66の10 with 労働安全衛生規則 arts.52の9, 52の21: once a year at a workplace regularly employing 50 or more; held with the health checks here (entity_extension_data.health_check_month). A due day on a Saturday, Sunday or published holiday of the entity moves to the next working day (国税通則法 art.10(2); 地方税法 art.20の5(2); 行政機関の休日に関する法律 art.2).

DEPENDANT_DECLARATION_COLLECTION.name: 扶養控除等申告書の受理 (dependant declaration for the coming year)
DEPENDANT_DECLARATION_COLLECTION.description: Raises the obligation to collect the dependant declaration for the coming year with the December run.

references.title: 所得税法 art.194(1): "その年最初に給与等の支払を受ける日の前日まで"; arts.195の2, 198 for the year-end declarations; 所得税法施行規則 art.76の3 (seven years). Raised with the December run.

CHILDCARE_INDIVIDUAL_NOTICE.name: 妊娠・出産等の申出時の個別周知・意向確認 (individual notice on a pregnancy or birth report)
CHILDCARE_INDIVIDUAL_NOTICE.description: Raises the individual pregnancy and birth notice when prenatal leave or postnatal paternity leave is entered.

references.title: 育児・介護休業法 art.21(1) with 施行規則 arts.69の3, 69の4 and art.21の2 (意向聴取, from 1 October 2025)

EMERGENCY_PAYMENT.name: 非常時払 (emergency payment of earned wages)
EMERGENCY_PAYMENT.description: Raises the emergency payment obligation when an emergency advance is entered.

references.title: 労働基準法 art.25 with 施行規則 art.9: on request, for the listed emergencies.

DEPENDANT_CHANGE_NOTICE.name: 健康保険 被扶養者(異動)届 (dependant change)
DEPENDANT_CHANGE_NOTICE.description: Raises the dependant-change notification when a dependant-change case is entered.

references.title: 健康保険法施行規則 art.38: within 5 days of the change — a workplace_case of kind DEPENDANT_CHANGE (changed_on, else its opening day) of an employment insured for health insurance on that day; the due day counts the day of the change itself, as the acquisition notice. A due day on a Saturday, Sunday or published holiday of the entity moves to the next working day (国税通則法 art.10(2); 地方税法 art.20の5(2); 行政機関の休日に関する法律 art.2).

PERSONAL_DATA_DISPOSAL.name: 特定個人情報・個人データの廃棄 (disposal after retention)
PERSONAL_DATA_DISPOSAL.description: Raises the personal-data disposal reminder after the retention period following exit.

references.title: 番号法 art.20 and the 特定個人情報の適正な取扱いに関するガイドライン（事業者編）第4-3-(3): 特定個人情報 kept for a statutory retention period is deleted or disposed of promptly after it; 個人情報保護法 art.22. Due when the retention ends (10 January of the eighth year after the exit year).

SOCIAL_INSURANCE_OFFICE_CHANGE.name: 適用事業所 名称・所在地変更届 (office name or location change)
SOCIAL_INSURANCE_OFFICE_CHANGE.description: Raises the social-insurance office change notification when a sealed entity version is updated.

references.title: 健康保険法施行規則 art.30 and 厚生年金保険法施行規則 art.23: within 5 days of a change in the business owner’s name, the office’s name or its location (entity name or region; row.before). The due day counts the day of the change, as the acquisition notice. A due day on a Saturday, Sunday or published holiday of the entity moves to the next working day (行政機関の休日に関する法律 art.2).

LABOUR_INSURANCE_OFFICE_CHANGE.name: 労働保険 名称・所在地等変更届 / 雇用保険 事業主事業所各種変更届 (labour insurance change)
LABOUR_INSURANCE_OFFICE_CHANGE.description: Raises the labour-insurance office change notification when a sealed entity version is updated.

references.title: 労働保険の保険料の徴収等に関する法律 art.4の2(2) with 施行規則 art.5 (the owner’s name, the business’s name, place or kind) and 雇用保険法施行規則 art.142: within 10 days counted from the day after the change (entity name, region or ei_industry_class; row.before).

PERSONAL_DATA_BREACH_PRELIMINARY.name: 個人データ漏えい等 速報 (preliminary breach report)
PERSONAL_DATA_BREACH_PRELIMINARY.description: Raises the preliminary personal-data breach report when a reportable breach case is entered.

references.title: 個人情報保護法 art.26(1) with 施行規則 arts.7–8: a leak (漏えい・滅失・毀損) of employee data is reported to the 個人情報保護委員会 where it involves 要配慮個人情報 (sensitive), property harm (financial_harm), an unlawful purpose (misconduct) or more than 1,000 people (affected_count); 番号法 art.29の4 with 特定個人情報の漏えい等に関する報告等に関する規則 art.2: a My Number leak (my_number) of more than 100 people. Counted from the day it was discovered (discovered_on, else the case’s opening day). 施行規則 art.8(1): promptly — the commission’s guidelines read it as about 3 to 5 days: due on the 5th day.

PERSONAL_DATA_BREACH_FINAL.name: 個人データ漏えい等 確報 (final breach report)
PERSONAL_DATA_BREACH_FINAL.description: Raises the final personal-data breach report when a reportable breach case is entered.

references.title: 個人情報保護法 art.26(1) with 施行規則 arts.7–8: a leak (漏えい・滅失・毀損) of employee data is reported to the 個人情報保護委員会 where it involves 要配慮個人情報 (sensitive), property harm (financial_harm), an unlawful purpose (misconduct) or more than 1,000 people (affected_count); 番号法 art.29の4 with 特定個人情報の漏えい等に関する報告等に関する規則 art.2: a My Number leak (my_number) of more than 100 people. Counted from the day it was discovered (discovered_on, else the case’s opening day). 施行規則 art.8(2): within 30 days of discovery, 60 where the leak was made for an unlawful purpose.

PERSONAL_DATA_BREACH_NOTICE.name: 個人データ漏えい等 本人通知 (notice to the people affected)
PERSONAL_DATA_BREACH_NOTICE.description: Raises the notice to affected people when a reportable breach case is entered.

references.title: 個人情報保護法 art.26(2) with 施行規則 art.10: promptly, on a reportable leak; 番号法 art.29の4(2).

YEAR_END_DECLARATIONS_COLLECTION.name: 年末調整の各種申告書の受理 (year-end declarations)
YEAR_END_DECLARATIONS_COLLECTION.description: Raises the obligation to collect the year-end tax declarations with the December run.

references.title: 所得税法 arts.190, 195の2 (基礎控除申告書, 配偶者控除等申告書, 所得金額調整控除申告書 — 租税特別措置法 art.41の3の4), 196 (保険料控除申告書) and 租税特別措置法 art.41の2の2 (住宅借入金等特別控除申告書): by the day of the last salary payment of the year, when the adjustment is made. Raised on the December run, due on its pay day.

RETIREMENT_AGE_RULES.name: 定年・継続雇用制度の整備 (retirement age and continued employment)
RETIREMENT_AGE_RULES.description: Raises the retirement-age and continued-employment rules reminder when an entity version is sealed without a lawful measure.

references.title: 高年齢者等の雇用の安定等に関する法律 art.8 (a retirement age below 60 is void), art.9(1) (高年齢者雇用確保措置 to 65; entity_extension_data.continued_employment_measure) and art.10の2 (高年齢者就業確保措置 to 70, an effort duty). Raised when the entity records a retirement age (the effect's retirement_age) that breaches them.

CONTINUED_EMPLOYMENT_CONFIRMATION.name: 継続雇用の希望確認 (continued employment past the retirement age)
CONTINUED_EMPLOYMENT_CONFIRMATION.description: Raises the continued-employment confirmation before the worker reaches the retirement age.

references.title: 高年齢者等の雇用の安定等に関する法律 art.9(1)(ii): under a continued-employment system everyone who wishes is kept to 65. Raised three months before the worker reaches the retirement age (the effect's retirement_age below 65), due the day it is reached (the day before the birthday, 年齢計算ニ関スル法律).

INDUSTRIAL_HEALTH_STAFF.name: 産業医・衛生管理者の選任 (industrial physician and health supervisor at 50 workers)
INDUSTRIAL_HEALTH_STAFF.description: Raises the industrial-physician and health-supervisor appointment reminder when the entity reaches fifty workers.

references.title: 労働安全衛生法 arts.12, 13, 18 with 労働安全衛生規則 arts.7(1)(i), 13(1)(i) and 2(2)/(13(2)): a workplace regularly employing 50 or more workers appoints both within 14 days of reaching 50 and reports without delay (様式第3号). Raised on a hire that brings the entity’s headcount to 50 or more, once (occurrence), unless the entity records the appointment (entity_extension_data.industrial_physician_appointed_on). The headcount is the entity’s contracts in force; a multi-site entity counts each 事業場 (counted by worksite).

MINOR_AGE_CERTIFICATE.name: 年少者の証明書 (age certificate of a worker under 18)
MINOR_AGE_CERTIFICATE.description: Raises the age-certificate obligation when a worker under 18 is hired.

references.title: 労働基準法 art.57(1) with 年少者労働基準規則 art.1: the employer keeps at the workplace a certificate of the age of each worker under 18 (a 住民票記載事項の証明書 suffices; 昭和50年2月17日 基発83号). Raised on the hire of a worker under 18 on the hire day.

OVERTIME_MONTHLY_45H.name: 時間外労働の限度時間 45時間 (monthly overtime limit)
OVERTIME_MONTHLY_45H.description: Raises the monthly 45-hour overtime-limit warning from the run's payslip.

lookup.message: Overtime above 45 hours this month: lawful only under the special clause of the 36 agreement, and in at most six months a year (労働基準法 art.36(4)–(5)).

references.title: 労働基準法 art.36(3)–(5): the limit is 45 hours a month and 360 hours a year; a special clause may exceed 45 hours in at most six months a year (働き方改革関連法, in force for all employers since April 2020). The yearly 360/720-hour totals and the 2–6 month 80-hour average need hours of earlier months, which no root carries.

OVERTIME_REST_DAY_100H.name: 時間外・休日労働 100時間未満 (absolute monthly cap)
OVERTIME_REST_DAY_100H.description: Raises the monthly 100-hour overtime and rest-day limit warning from the run's payslip.

lookup.message: Overtime and statutory rest-day work reached 100 hours this month; the law requires under 100 even under a special clause (労働基準法 art.36(6)(ii)).

references.title: 労働基準法 art.36(6)(ii): overtime and rest-day work together must be under 100 hours in each month; art.119 (penalty). The wages are still owed, so the slip warns rather than refuses.

OVERTIME_WITHOUT_AGREEMENT.name: 36協定の有効期間外の時間外労働 (overtime outside the 36 agreement)
OVERTIME_WITHOUT_AGREEMENT.description: Raises the overtime-without-agreement warning when rostered overtime falls outside the filed 36 agreement.

lookup.message: Overtime falls outside the period of the 36 agreement on record (entity_extension_data.overtime_agreement_from/to); overtime needs an agreement filed with the labour standards office (労働基準法 arts.32, 36(1)).

references.title: 労働基準法 art.36(1): overtime and rest-day work are lawful only under a written agreement filed with the labour standards office; customer input: entity_extension_data.overtime_agreement_from, overtime_agreement_to.

OVERTIME_YEAR_360H.name: 時間外労働の限度時間 年360時間 (yearly overtime limit)
OVERTIME_YEAR_360H.description: Raises the annual 360-hour overtime-limit warning from the run's payslip.

lookup.message: Overtime in this agreement year is above 360 hours: lawful only under the special clause of the 36 agreement (労働基準法 art.36(4)–(5)).

references.title: 労働基準法 art.36(2)(iv), (4): 360 hours a year counted from the agreement's 起算日 (entity_extension_data.overtime_agreement_from; else 1 January) over hours.months. 新技術・新商品等の研究開発 is outside the limits (art.36(11)). hours.months does not split rest-day work or within-legal-hours overtime (every approved hour past the schedule) from statutory overtime, so the count includes them and errs high.

OVERTIME_YEAR_720H.name: 特別条項の上限 年720時間 (yearly cap under a special clause)
OVERTIME_YEAR_720H.description: Raises the annual 720-hour special-clause cap warning from the run's payslip.

lookup.message: Overtime in this agreement year is above the yearly cap even under a special clause (720 hours; 960 for drivers and A-level doctors, 1,860 for B/C doctors) (労働基準法 arts.36(5), 140–141).

references.title: 労働基準法 art.36(5); from April 2024 drivers 960 h (art.140), doctors by level (art.141 with 医師の労働時間短縮 省令) (entity_extension_data.overtime_sector). hours.months and hours.month/year carry every approved hour past the schedule, within-legal-hours overtime included, so this count errs high.

OVERTIME_AVERAGE_80H.name: 複数月平均80時間以内 (2- to 6-month average cap)
OVERTIME_AVERAGE_80H.description: Raises the multi-month 80-hour average overtime warning from the run's payslip.

lookup.message: Overtime and rest-day work average more than 80 hours a month over a 2- to 6-month span (労働基準法 art.36(6)(iii)).

references.title: 労働基準法 art.36(6)(iii) over hours.months: each month’s overtime beyond the statutory limits plus every hour worked on a statutory rest day (法定休日, day_type REST: the approved overtime of those days is counted once, as rest-day work); work on another day off (所定休日, OFF) or a national holiday counts as overtime only where it exceeds the limits. Not applied to drivers, doctors, R&D or disaster recovery in construction (arts.139–141). hours.months and hours.month/year carry every approved hour past the schedule, within-legal-hours overtime included, so this count errs high.

OVERTIME_SIX_MONTHS_OVER_45.name: 45時間超は年6か月まで (at most six months above 45 hours)
OVERTIME_SIX_MONTHS_OVER_45.description: Raises the warning when more than six months in the agreement year exceed 45 overtime hours.

lookup.message: More than six months in this agreement year have overtime above 45 hours (労働基準法 art.36(5)).

references.title: 労働基準法 art.36(5): the special clause may exceed 45 hours a month in at most six months of the agreement year (hours.months from the 起算日). hours.months and hours.month/year carry every approved hour past the schedule, within-legal-hours overtime included, so this count errs high.

OVERTIME_80H_NOTICE.name: 月80時間超の時間外・休日労働 (over 80 hours: notice and doctor interview)
OVERTIME_80H_NOTICE.description: Raises the obligation to notify and interview a worker over 80 overtime hours in a month.

lookup.message: Overtime and rest-day work exceed 80 hours this month: tell the worker promptly and arrange the doctor's interview on request (労働安全衛生法 art.66の8; 安衛則 arts.52の2–52の3).

references.title: 労働安全衛生法 arts.66の8, 66の8の3 with 安衛則 art.52の2: the employer grasps everyone's hours (managers included) and informs a worker above 80 hours a month.

MINOR_LIMITS.name: 年少者の時間外・休日・深夜労働 (minors: no overtime, rest-day or night work)
MINOR_LIMITS.description: Raises the minors' overtime, rest-day and night-work limit warning from the run's payslip.

lookup.message: A worker under 18 did overtime, rest-day or night work, which the law forbids (労働基準法 arts.60–61).

references.title: 労働基準法 art.60(1) (no 36-agreement overtime or rest-day work) and art.61(1) (no work 22:00–05:00), with the listed exceptions.

MATERNITY_LIMITS.name: 妊産婦の請求による時間外・休日・深夜の制限 (pregnant and post-partum workers)
MATERNITY_LIMITS.description: Raises the pregnant or post-partum worker's requested limits warning from the run's payslip.

lookup.message: A pregnant or post-partum worker who asked to be excused did overtime, rest-day or night work (労働基準法 art.66).

references.title: 労働基準法 art.66(2)–(3): on the worker's request no overtime, rest-day or night work (workplace case PREGNANCY_WORK_LIMIT_REQUEST).

CHILDCARE_CARE_LIMITS.name: 育児・介護のための時間外・深夜の制限 (childcare and care limits)
CHILDCARE_CARE_LIMITS.description: Raises the childcare or care limits warning from the run's payslip.

lookup.message: A worker who asked for the childcare or care limits did more overtime or night work than allowed (育児・介護休業法 arts.16の8, 17, 19).

references.title: 育児・介護休業法 art.16の8 (no work beyond the schedule, to pre-school age from April 2025), art.17 (at most 24 h a month and 150 h a year), art.19 (no night work), on request (the workplace-case entry). hours.months and hours.month/year carry every approved hour past the schedule, within-legal-hours overtime included, so this count errs high.

DAYTIME_STUDENT_EI.name: 昼間学生の雇用保険適用 (daytime students outside employment insurance)
DAYTIME_STUDENT_EI.description: Raises the daytime-student employment-insurance coverage warning from the run's payslip.

lookup.message: A daytime student is not insured for employment insurance (雇用保険法 art.6(iv)); check the coverage on the terms.

references.title: 雇用保険法 art.6(iv) with 施行規則 art.3の2; a worker 65 or over with several jobs is insured only on application (art.37の5, マルチジョブホルダー).

SHORT_TIME_COVERAGE.name: 短時間労働者の社会保険適用 (short-time worker coverage)
SHORT_TIME_COVERAGE.description: Raises the short-time worker social-insurance coverage warning from the run's payslip.

lookup.message: The captured social-insurance category differs from the short-time requirements and the actual governing pension-office notice or voluntary approval.

references.title: 健康保険法art.3(1)(ix), 厚生年金保険法art.12(v): actual pension-office specific-application notice or approved voluntary coverage establishes employer status. Do not substitute raw current headcount for the qualified same-legal-entity insured population. Other individual eligibility and actual ordinary-worker comparison remain separate legal

DISCIPLINARY_DEDUCTION_LIMIT.name: 減給の総額制限 (disciplinary reductions above one tenth)
DISCIPLINARY_DEDUCTION_LIMIT.description: Raises the warning when disciplinary deductions exceed one tenth of the period's wages.

lookup.message: Disciplinary reductions exceed one tenth of the period's wages (労働基準法 art.91); carry the rest to a later period.

references.title: 労働基準法 art.91: in all at most one tenth of the wages of one pay period.

DIGITAL_WAGE_CONSENT.name: 賃金のデジタル払いの同意 (digital wage payment consent)
DIGITAL_WAGE_CONSENT.description: Raises the warning when digital wage payment lacks a valid employee consent.

lookup.message: Wages paid to a designated fund-transfer account need the worker's written consent (労働基準法施行規則 art.7の2(1)(iii)).

references.title: 労働基準法 art.24(1) with 施行規則 art.7の2: payment through a 指定資金移動業者 only with the worker's consent after the required explanation.

EI_COVERAGE_HOURS.name: 雇用保険の適用 (employment insurance by weekly hours)
EI_COVERAGE_HOURS.description: Raises the employment-insurance coverage warning when weekly hours and the recorded category disagree.

lookup.message: Employment insurance coverage does not match the weekly hours: 20 hours or more a week is insured (雇用保険法 art.6(i)).

references.title: 雇用保険法 art.6(i): a worker of under 20 scheduled hours a week is outside employment insurance (20 before 1 October 2028; 雇用保険法等の一部を改正する法律, 令和6年法律第26号, lowers it to 10 from that day); a daytime student (art.6(iv), employee_extension_data.daytime_student) is outside it whatever the hours. terms.statutory_work_category records the coverage.

JP_STANDARD_SHIFT_OVERTIME.name: Statutory overtime cannot be hidden inside a planned ordinary shift
JP_STANDARD_SHIFT_OVERTIME.description: Raises the warning that a standard shift longer than eight hours hides statutory overtime from the price.

lookup.message: A standard shift has more than8 ordinary hours. Reclassify and approve the statutory overtime before payroll; the ordinary shift cannot absorb its required premium.

references.title: Statutory overtime cannot be hidden inside a planned ordinary shift

PREMIUM_EXEMPTION_CHARGED.name: 育休・産休の保険料免除月の控除 (premium charged in an exempt month)
PREMIUM_EXEMPTION_CHARGED.description: Raises the correction when a premium is charged in a month exempt for maternity or childcare leave.

lookup.message: A health or pension premium was charged in a month a maternity or childcare leave exempts: refund it (健康保険法 arts.159, 159の3; 厚生年金保険法 arts.81の2, 81の2の2).

references.title: 健康保険法 arts.159, 159の3; 厚生年金保険法 arts.81の2, 81の2の2: premiums are exempt from the month the leave starts to the month before the one holding the day after it ends, and in a month with 14 days or more of childcare leave. No calculation reads a leave entry, so the premium is still charged and this raises the correction.

RETIREMENT_DECLARATION_MISSING.name: 退職所得の受給に関する申告書の未受領 (retirement pay without the declaration)
RETIREMENT_DECLARATION_MISSING.description: Raises the warning when retirement pay is paid without the retirement-income declaration.

lookup.message: Retirement pay was withheld as declared but no 退職所得の受給に関する申告書 is on record: without it the rate is 20.42% (所得税法 art.201(3)); use RETIREMENT_ALLOWANCE_UNDECLARED.

MINIMUM_WAGE_CONTRACT.description: Refuses a contract whose hourly, daily or monthly rate is below the regional minimum wage in force on the contract's first day.

references.title: 最低賃金法 arts.4, 7, 13 with 施行規則 arts.1–2: the minimum in force on the term's day (day) of the workplace's prefecture, less a permitted reduction, compared per hour.

ROSTER_DAILY_8H.description: Refuses a day worked beyond 8 hours while no filed 36 agreement covers the date.

references.title: 法定労働時間 1日8時間 (労働基準法 art.32(2)); beyond it only under a filed 36 agreement (art.36(1); entity_extension_data.overtime_agreement_from/to) or in an emergency (art.33). Not for managers (art.41(ii)) or a variable, flex or deemed regime (entity_extension_data.working_time_regime). A worked day is a fact to correct, not to refuse: warn.

ROSTER_WEEKLY_40H.description: Refuses a week worked beyond 40 hours (44 for a listed small establishment) while no filed 36 agreement covers the date.

references.title: 法定労働時間 1週40時間 (労働基準法 art.32(1)), 44 hours for a 特例措置対象事業場 (施行規則 art.25の2; entity_extension_data.weekly_limit_44); the week is the calendar week from entity_extension_data.week_start (昭和63年1月1日 基発1号), read on its last day.

ROSTER_OVERTIME_UNRECORDED.description: Refuses a planned ordinary shift longer than 8 hours because the hours beyond 8 are statutory overtime the planned price does not include.

references.title: 労働基準法 art.32(2) (8 hours a day) and art.37(1) (割増賃金 on every hour beyond it) and art.24 (full payment): overtime is every hour past the planned shift’s ordinary hours, so ordinary hours planned beyond 8 a day would carry the statutory premium unpriced. Not for managers (art.41(ii)) or a variable, flex or deemed regime (entity_extension_data.working_time_regime).

ROSTER_BREAK.description: Refuses a shift whose break is under 45 minutes after 6 hours or under one hour after 8 hours.

references.title: 労働基準法 art.34(1): a break of at least 45 minutes where the working time exceeds 6 hours and 1 hour where it exceeds 8, within the working time; the break is the gaps between the day’s clock intervals, and the working time is the time inside them (not the paid hours, which count the planned hours on a day left early). Not for managers (art.41).

ROSTER_REST_DAY.description: Refuses a week with no rest day.

references.title: 労働基準法 art.35(1): at least one rest day each week, unless the work rules use 4 rest days in 4 weeks (art.35(2); entity_extension_data.variable_rest_days). Rest-day work needs a 36 agreement and the 35% premium (arts.36, 37).

ROSTER_MINOR_OVERTIME.description: Refuses overtime beyond 8 hours or rest-day work recorded for a worker under 18.

references.title: 労働基準法 art.60(1): the 36 agreement (art.36) does not apply to a worker under 18, so no work beyond 8 hours a day or on the statutory rest day; overtime within 8 hours (past a shorter schedule) is lawful. Every hour past the schedule is approved overtime, so recording it is the forbidden instruction and the file is refused (an emergency under art.33 is not distinguished).

ROSTER_MINOR_HOURS.description: Refuses a worker under 18 working beyond 8 hours a day or 40 hours a week.

references.title: 労働基準法 art.60(1), (3): no variable-hours or 36-agreement extension for a minor beyond the art.60(3) exceptions.

ROSTER_MINOR_NIGHT.description: Refuses night work between 22:00 and 05:00 recorded for a worker under 18.

references.title: 労働基準法 art.61(1): no night work for a worker under 18, except a male of 16 or over in a shift system (proviso) and the art.61(3)–(4) cases.

ROSTER_MATERNITY_OVERTIME.description: Refuses overtime beyond 8 hours or rest-day work recorded for a pregnant or post-partum worker who asked to be excused.

references.title: 労働基準法 art.66(2): on the request of an 妊産婦 (workplace case PREGNANCY_WORK_LIMIT_REQUEST) the employer shall not make her work overtime beyond the statutory hours or on a rest day; every hour past the schedule is approved overtime, so a day beyond 8 hours or rest-day work is refused.

ROSTER_MATERNITY_NIGHT.description: Refuses night work recorded for a pregnant or post-partum worker who asked to be excused.

references.title: 労働基準法 art.66(3): no night work on the 妊産婦’s request.

ROSTER_CHILDCARE_OVERTIME.description: Refuses work beyond the scheduled hours recorded for a worker who asked to be excused from overtime for childcare or care.

references.title: 育児・介護休業法 arts.16の8–16の9: a worker caring for a child before school age (from April 2025) or a family member who asks (workplace case CHILDCARE_NO_OVERTIME_REQUEST) shall not be made to work beyond the scheduled hours: the approval is refused.

ROSTER_CHILDCARE_NIGHT.description: Refuses night work recorded for a worker who asked to be excused from night work for childcare or care.

references.title: 育児・介護休業法 arts.19–20 (workplace case CHILDCARE_NIGHT_WORK_EXEMPTION_REQUEST)

ROSTER_HAZARDOUS_OVERTIME.description: Refuses more than 2 hours of overtime in a day on work harmful to health.

references.title: 労働基準法 art.36(6)(i) with 施行規則 art.18: 坑内労働 and the listed harmful work may run at most 2 hours beyond the daily limit, even under a 36 agreement (employee_extension_data.hazardous_work).

ROSTER_REST_INTERVAL.description: Refuses less rest between the end of one day's work and the next than the employer's interval or, for drivers, the 9-hour statutory floor.

references.title: 労働時間等の設定の改善に関する特別措置法 art.2(1) (the employer’s duty to try to secure rest between shifts; entity_extension_data.work_interval_hours, the interval its rules adopt); for drivers the 改善基準告示 (令和4年厚生労働省告示第367号) sets at least 9 hours (entity_extension_data.overtime_sector DRIVER).

ROSTER_LEAVE_ON_WORKED_DAY.description: Refuses leave recorded on a day that also has attendance.

references.title: 労働基準法 art.39 (annual leave is a release from the duty to work on that day) and art.108 with 施行規則 art.54(1)(ii)–(iii) (the wage ledger records the days and hours worked): a day cannot be both.

WAGE_PAYMENT_MONTHLY.description: Refuses an entity pay frequency other than at least monthly on a fixed day.
WAGE_PAYMENT_MONTHLY.validate:
const schedule = get(ctx.subject.employer, 'payment_schedule', {});
return get(schedule, 'frequency', null) !== ctx.lookup.forbidden_frequency;

references.title: 労働基準法 art.24(2): wages are paid at least once a month on a fixed day, except bonuses and the payments 施行規則 art.8 lists; an INTEGER_MONTHS pay frequency is for those only.

JP_PRENATAL_WINDOW.description: Refuses prenatal leave days outside the 6-week (14-week multiple pregnancy) window before the expected birth.

references.title: 労働基準法 art.65(1): on request, from 6 weeks before the expected birth (14 weeks for a multiple pregnancy); the day of birth counts as prenatal and a birth later than expected extends the leave.

JP_ANNUAL_LEAVE_HOURS_CAP.description: Refuses annual leave taken in hours beyond 5 days in the grant year.

references.title: 労働基準法 art.39(4)(ii) with 施行規則 art.24の4: up to 5 days a year, days carried over included.

CONTRACT_CATEGORIES.description: Refuses a contract whose work classification, statutory work category, residency status or wage payment method is not permitted by the version.

references.title: 労働基準法
references.quote: 労働契約の締結に際し、賃金、労働時間その他の労働条件を明示しなければならない。

PAYROLL_OFFICE_EVENT_DATE_REQUIRED.description: Requires the registered salary-payment office opening date when the entity names a withholding tax office.

references.title: 所得税法
references.locator: 230条（給与支払事務所等の開設届出）
references.quote: 給与支払事務所等を開設した日から一月以内に届け出る。

BUSINESS_CASE_SUBJECT_AND_REFERENCE.description: Requires the employee and a source or request reference on the listed employee business cases.
BUSINESS_CASE_SUBJECT_AND_REFERENCE.validate:
if (!ctx.lookup.case_kinds.includes(ctx.entry.kind)) return true;
return ctx.entry.employment_id != null && get(ctx.entry, 'reference', '') !== '';

references.title: 労働基準法
references.quote: 労働条件の変更は、書面の交付その他の方法で明示する。

BUSINESS_CASE_EFFECTIVE_INTERVAL.description: Requires an effective interval on the listed business cases, beginning on or after receipt and ending no earlier than it starts.

references.title: 労働基準法
references.quote: 労働条件の変更は、実際の効力発生日を明らかにして行う。

BUSINESS_CASE_SIGNED_CONSENT.description: Requires a prior signature date and the signed document on a digital wage payment consent.

references.title: 労働基準法
references.quote: 賃金控除は、労使協定がある場合に限り許される。

DIGITAL_CONSENT_EFFECTIVE_DATE.description: Requires digital wage payment consent to take effect on or after its receipt.

references.title: 労働基準法
references.locator: 24条1項、労働基準法施行規則7条の2（デジタル払い）
references.quote: デジタル払いには、労働者の同意と厚生労働大臣の指定を受けた資金移動業者の口座を要する。

ESTABLISHMENT_EVENT_DATES_REQUIRED.description: Requires the social, labour and employment insurance establishment dates on the sealed entity version.

references.title: 健康保険法施行規則 art.19; 厚生年金保険法施行規則 art.13; 労働保険徴収法 art.4の2; 雇用保険法施行規則 art.141: each establishment date is the actual statutory fact, not the incorporation date or the first contract.

WORK_WEEK_START_REQUIRED.description: Requires the weekday the statutory week opens on, from Sunday (0) to Saturday (6), on the sealed entity version.

references.title: 労働基準法 art.32: the statutory week is the calendar week from Sunday to Saturday unless the work rules set another start (昭和63年1月1日 基発1号); the same start is used by every 40-hour and overtime computation.

MINIMUM_WAGE_HOURS_REQUIRED.description: Requires the contract's annual prescribed hours when a variable, flex or deemed schedule makes the monthly minimum-wage conversion impossible.

references.title: 最低賃金法施行規則 art.2(1)(3): a monthly wage is converted using the month’s prescribed hours, or the annual average monthly prescribed hours where they vary by month.

entity_extension_schema.title: JP entity extension data
entity_extension_schema.description: entity_extension_data. The entity region is the prefecture code of the prefectures rule set (HOKKAIDO … OKINAWA): it selects the 協会けんぽ rate and the regional minimum wage.

ei_industry_class.title: 雇用保険の事業の種類
ei_industry_class.description: 徴収法 art.12(4): general, agriculture/forestry/fisheries/sake brewing (with the listed exceptions that take the general rate), or construction.

workers_accident_rate_per_mille.title: 労災保険率 (per mille)
workers_accident_rate_per_mille.description: 徴収法 art.12(2)–(3) with 施行規則 別表第一: the rate of the business type (令和6年度改定) or the merit-adjusted rate on the labour insurance notice.

wage_deduction_agreement.title: 賃金控除協定 concluded
wage_deduction_agreement.description: 労働基準法 art.24(1) proviso: a written agreement with the majority union or representative permits deductions other than taxes and social insurance (loan recovery). Without it no loan class is offered.

withholding_semiannual_special.title: 源泉所得税の納期の特例
withholding_semiannual_special.description: 所得税法 art.216: approved semi-annual payment for an office paying fewer than 10 employees; raises WITHHOLDING_TAX_SEMIANNUAL instead of WITHHOLDING_TAX_PAYMENT.

resident_tax_semiannual_special.title: 住民税の納期の特例
resident_tax_semiannual_special.description: 地方税法 art.321の5の2: approved semi-annual payment for an office paying fewer than 10 employees (常時十人未満).

regular_employee_count.title: 常時雇用する労働者の数
regular_employee_count.description: Regular employees for the headcount-bound duties: the disability employment report (障害者雇用促進法 art.43(7); a short-time worker of 20–30 hours counts 0.5), the disability levy (100+). Unrecorded, the entity's employments in force (headcount) are counted.

health_insurer.title: 健康保険の保険者
health_insurer.description: 協会けんぽ (KYOKAI) or a 健康保険組合 (SOCIETY); a society employer records its own rates below.

society_health_rate_percent.title: 健康保険組合の一般保険料率 (%)
society_health_rate_percent.description: 健康保険法 art.160(13): the society's rate, within 3%–13%.

society_care_rate_percent.title: 健康保険組合の介護保険料率 (%)

society_support_levy_rate_percent.title: 健康保険組合の子ども・子育て支援金率 (%)
society_support_levy_rate_percent.description: 健康保険法 art.160の2: each insurer sets its own; unrecorded is 0.23%.

society_employee_share.title: 被保険者負担割合
society_employee_share.description: 健康保険法 art.162: a society may raise the employer's share; unrecorded is one half.

overtime_agreement_to.title: 36協定 有効期間の末日
overtime_agreement_to.description: 労働基準法 art.36: the filed agreement's last day; raises OVERTIME_AGREEMENT_RENEWAL and dates OVERTIME_WITHOUT_AGREEMENT.

overtime_special_clause.title: 特別条項付き
overtime_special_clause.description: 労働基準法 art.36(5): the agreement allows exceeding 45 h a month / 360 h a year.

labour_insurance_instalments.title: 労働保険料の延納
labour_insurance_instalments.description: 徴収法 art.18: the provisional premium is paid in three instalments (10 July, 31 October, 31 January).

weekly_limit_44.title: 特例措置対象事業場（週44時間）
weekly_limit_44.description: 労働基準法施行規則 art.25の2: under 10 workers in commerce, cinema/theatre, health or hospitality.

working_time_regime.title: 労働時間制度
working_time_regime.description: STANDARD, VARIABLE (変形労働時間制), FLEX (フレックスタイム制, one-month settlement) or DEEMED (みなし・裁量労働).

overtime_sector.title: 時間外労働の上限規制の区分
overtime_sector.description: GENERAL, CONSTRUCTION, DRIVER (960 h), DOCTOR_A (960 h), DOCTOR_BC (1,860 h) or NEW_TECH_RD (outside the limits) (労働基準法 arts.36(11), 139–141).

disaster_recovery_work.title: 災害時の復旧・復興事業
disaster_recovery_work.description: Construction disaster recovery: the 100-hour and 80-hour rules do not apply (art.139).

statutory_return_count_two_years_prior.title: 基準年の法定調書の枚数
statutory_return_count_two_years_prior.description: Returns of a kind due two years before (所得税法 art.228の4).

work_rules_filed_on.title: 就業規則の届出日
work_rules_filed_on.description: The latest filing of the work rules (労働基準法 art.89).

next_generation_plan_until.title: 次世代法行動計画の終期
next_generation_plan_until.description: The end of the current next-generation action plan.

women_action_plan_until.title: 女性活躍行動計画の終期
women_action_plan_until.description: The end of the current women's advancement action plan.

health_check_month.title: 定期健康診断の実施月
health_check_month.description: The month the periodic health checks and the stress check are held (安衛則 arts.44, 52の9).

labour_insurance_association.title: 労働保険事務組合に委託
labour_insurance_association.description: Instalments fall on 14 November and 14 February (徴収則 art.28(2)).

variable_rest_days.title: 変形休日制（4週4日）
variable_rest_days.description: 労働基準法 art.35(2): four rest days in four weeks instead of one a week.

continued_employment_measure.title: 高年齢者雇用確保措置

yea_housing_loan_credit.title: 住宅借入金等特別控除額

yea_income_adjustment.title: 所得金額調整控除額
yea_income_adjustment.description: YEAR_END_ADJUSTMENT: 租税特別措置法 art.41の3の11 (salary over 8,500,000 with a dependant under 23 or disabled).

yea_insurance_deductions.title: 生命保険料・地震保険料・小規模企業共済等掛金控除額
yea_insurance_deductions.description: YEAR_END_ADJUSTMENT: from the 保険料控除申告書.

yea_other_income.description: YEAR_END_ADJUSTMENT: other income on the 基礎控除申告書, for the basic deduction tier.

june_amount.description: RESIDENT_TAX. 地方税法 art.321の4: the June amount on the municipality's 特別徴収税額決定通知書.

lump_sum_on_exit.title: 一括徴収の申出

monthly_amount.description: RESIDENT_TAX. 地方税法 art.321の4: the monthly amount from July to May on the notice; replaced each June. Unrecorded is no special collection.

commute_car_km_one_way.title: Car commuting distance, one way (km)
commute_car_km_one_way.description: 所得税法施行令 art.20の2(ii): the non-taxable limit of a car or bicycle commuter's allowance by one-way distance. Unrecorded is a public-transport commuter (150,000 cap).

commute_parking_fee.description: From 1 April 2026 (令和8年度改正): a qualifying car park fee the commuter regularly bears adds up to 5,000 a month to the car limit.

commute_transit_fare.title: Monthly reasonable transit fare (yen)
commute_transit_fare.description: 所得税法施行令 art.20の2(iv): a commuter using both transport and a car adds the reasonable fare to the car limit, at most 150,000 a month.

insured_office_region.title: 適用事業所の都道府県
insured_office_region.description: The prefecture of the 適用事業所 the worker is insured at, where it is not the entity's (the 協会けんぽ 支部 rate).

minimum_wage_reduction_rate.description: The reduction the labour bureau permitted for this worker (最低賃金法 art.7), as a fraction.

daytime_student.title: 昼間学生
daytime_student.description: A daytime student, outside employment insurance (雇用保険法 art.6(iv)) and the short-time coverage.

childcare_short_hours.title: 育児短時間勤務
childcare_short_hours.description: The term is a 育児のための所定労働時間の短縮措置 (育児・介護休業法 art.23(1)); raises the 育児時短就業給付 application.

older_worker_continuation_benefit.title: 高年齢雇用継続給付 受給中
older_worker_continuation_benefit.description: 雇用保険法 art.61: the 60–64 worker’s wage fell below 75% of the 60歳到達時賃金 and the benefit is claimed (raises the two-monthly applications).

daily_wage_earner.title: 日雇（労働した日ごとに支払われる給与）
daily_wage_earner.description: 所得税法 art.185(1)(iii): pay paid for each day worked to a worker engaged by the day — withheld on the 丙欄. Not for pay continuing over two months (the part beyond two months is not 日雇 pay).

hazardous_work.title: 坑内労働・有害業務
hazardous_work.description: 労働基準法 art.36(6)(i) with 施行規則 art.18: overtime at most 2 hours a day.

departure_abroad.title: 出国による退職
departure_abroad.description: The leaver departs abroad (年末調整 at the exit, 所得税法 art.190).

renewal_count.title: 更新回数
renewal_count.description: Times the fixed-term contract was renewed (雇止め基準 art.1).

severe_disability_prevents_reemployment.description: Raw exit circumstance under所得税基本通達190-1(3): the employee leaves because of severe mental/physical disability and cannot be reemployed during the remaining tax year. This is not an annual-adjustment eligibility decision.

references.title: 労働基準法 art.24(1) proviso: a deduction from wages other than taxes and social insurance needs a written agreement with the majority union or representative (賃金控除協定; entity_extension_data.wage_deduction_agreement); art.25: an advance of wages already earned for an emergency must be paid on request.

SALARY_ADVANCE.description: Salary advance recovered from later pay.

references.title: 労働基準法 art.24(1) proviso (賃金控除協定 required) and art.17: a loan may not be set off against wages as a condition of work (前借金相殺の禁止); recovery by deduction is only the employee's voluntary repayment under the agreement.

労働基準法 art.25 with 施行規則 art.9: for childbirth, illness, disaster, marriage, death or an unavoidable trip of the worker or a dependant, the wages already earned are paid on request before the pay day; the advance is settled from that pay (task EMERGENCY_PAYMENT).

労働基準法 art.39(1)–(3), (10) with 施行規則 art.24の3: the grant needs 80% attendance over the six months or the year before the grant day. Work-injury, childcare, family care and maternity leave count as attended (art.39(10)), as does annual leave taken (昭22.9.13 発基17). A short schedule takes the table for its weekly or yearly days.

労働基準法 art.39(1)–(2): 10 working days after six months’ continuous service, then 11, 12, 14, 16, 18 and 20 from six years six months. art.115: the right lapses two years after it arises, so only the previous year’s unused days carry (厚生労働省 Q&A).

ANNUAL_LEAVE.description: Paid annual leave accrued by service. Paid as a normal day (paid_share 1).

references.title: 労働基準法 art.65(1): on request, from 6 weeks before the expected birth (14 weeks for a multiple pregnancy); the day of birth counts as prenatal and a birth later than expected extends the leave. The employer need not pay; 健康保険法 art.102 pays the 出産手当金 (two thirds of the standard daily remuneration) and art.159 exempts the premiums on the employer's application.

PRENATAL_LEAVE.description: Leave before childbirth. Unpaid by the employer (paid_share 0); any benefit comes from social insurance, not payroll.

references.title: 労働基準法 art.65(2): no work for 8 weeks after the birth (after 6 weeks the woman may work where a doctor approves). 健康保険法 art.102: 出産手当金 paid by the insurer; premiums exempt (健保法 art.159, 厚年法 art.81の2の2). Metered per birth (event_id): 56 days from the day after the birth.

POSTNATAL_LEAVE.description: Leave after childbirth. Unpaid by the employer (paid_share 0); any benefit comes from social insurance, not payroll.

references.title: 育児・介護休業法 arts.5–9: until the child is 1, extendable to 1½ and 2 where no childcare place is available, in up to two periods; 雇用保険法 arts.61の7 and 61の10: the 育児休業給付金 (67% for 180 days, then 50%) and, from April 2025, the 出生後休業支援給付金 are paid by employment insurance; health and pension premiums are exempt on application (健保法 art.159, 厚年法 art.81の2).

CHILDCARE_LEAVE.description: Childcare leave. Unpaid by the employer (paid_share 0); any benefit comes from social insurance, not payroll.

references.title: 育児・介護休業法 arts.9の2–9の5: up to 4 weeks within 8 weeks of the birth, in up to two periods, requested 2 weeks ahead; 雇用保険法 art.61の8: 出生時育児休業給付金 paid by employment insurance. Metered per birth (event_id): 28 days.

POSTNATAL_PATERNITY_LEAVE.description: Paternity leave after childbirth. Unpaid by the employer (paid_share 0); any benefit comes from social insurance, not payroll.

references.title: 育児・介護休業法 arts.11–15: up to 93 days for each family member in need of constant care, in up to three periods; 雇用保険法 art.61の4: 介護休業給付金 (67%) paid by employment insurance. Metered per family member (entry.care_recipient_id): 93 days in all.

FAMILY_CARE_LEAVE.description: Leave to care for a family member. Unpaid by the employer (paid_share 0); any benefit comes from social insurance, not payroll.

references.title: 育児・介護休業法 art.16の2 as amended from 1 April 2025: 5 days a business year (10 for two or more children) up to the end of the child's third year of elementary school, for illness, injury, vaccination, health checks, school closure, entrance or graduation ceremonies; in hours where requested; the law does not require pay. The business year runs from 1 April unless the work rules say otherwise (art.16の2(1) "一の年度").

CHILD_NURSING_LEAVE.description: Nursing breaks or leave for a child. Unpaid by the employer (paid_share 0); any benefit comes from social insurance, not payroll.

references.title: 育児・介護休業法 art.16の5: 5 days a business year from 1 April (10 for two or more family members needing care), takeable in hours; unpaid by law.

FAMILY_CARE_DAYS.description: Days to care for a family member. Unpaid by the employer (paid_share 0); any benefit comes from social insurance, not payroll.

references.title: 労働基準法 art.68: a woman for whom work on menstruation days is very difficult may not be made to work on request; the law does not require pay.

MENSTRUAL_LEAVE.description: Menstrual leave days. Unpaid by the employer (paid_share 0); any benefit comes from social insurance, not payroll.

references.title: 労働基準法 art.7: time needed to vote, serve as a lay judge (裁判員法 art.100) or perform a public duty must be granted; the law does not require pay.

CIVIC_DUTY_LEAVE.description: Leave for civic duty. Unpaid by the employer (paid_share 0); any benefit comes from social insurance, not payroll.

references.title: No statutory paid sick leave; 健康保険法 art.99 pays the 傷病手当金 (two thirds of the standard daily remuneration) from the fourth consecutive day of incapacity for up to 1 year 6 months in aggregate.

SICKNESS_ABSENCE.description: Unpaid sickness absence. Unpaid by the employer (paid_share 0); any benefit comes from social insurance, not payroll.

references.title: 労働者災害補償保険法 art.14: from the fourth day of absence the 休業補償給付 (60% of the 給付基礎日額, plus a 20% special payment) is paid by the insurance; the first three days are the employer's (労働基準法 art.76; adhoc INJURY_WAITING_COMPENSATION). art.19: no dismissal during the absence and 30 days after.

OCCUPATIONAL_INJURY_ABSENCE.description: Absence from an occupational injury. Unpaid by the employer (paid_share 0); any benefit comes from social insurance, not payroll.

references.title: Leave or absence the work rules leave unpaid (労働基準法 art.89(i) and the no-work-no-pay principle, 民法 art.624(1)); deducted by NO_PAY_LEAVE.

NPL.description: Unpaid absence from work. Unpaid by the employer (paid_share 0); any benefit comes from social insurance, not payroll.

references.title: 労働基準法 art.39(4) with 施行規則 art.24の4: under a labour-management agreement up to 5 days a year of annual leave may be taken in hours, the days drawn on the annual leave; a day is the scheduled daily hours, a part hour rounded up. Planned leave (計画的付与, art.39(6)) is a scheduling of the same days.

ANNUAL_LEAVE_HOURS.description: Annual leave taken in hours. Paid as a normal day (paid_share 1).

references.title: 労働基準法 art.67: a woman with a child under one may claim two periods of at least 30 minutes a day besides her breaks; the law does not require pay.

NURSING_TIME.description: Nursing time. Unpaid by the employer (paid_share 0); any benefit comes from social insurance, not payroll.

references.title: 男女雇用機会均等法 arts.12–13 with 施行規則 art.2の4: the employer must allow the time a pregnant or post-partum worker needs for health guidance and checks (every 4 weeks to week 23, 2 weeks to 35, then weekly) and act on the doctor's instructions; the law does not require pay.

MATERNAL_HEALTH_CHECK.description: Maternal health-check leave. Unpaid by the employer (paid_share 0); any benefit comes from social insurance, not payroll.

references.title: 労働基準法 art.37(3): under a written labour-management agreement, paid leave (通常の労働時間の賃金が支払われる休暇) may be given in place of the 割増賃金 for overtime beyond 60 hours in a month; the worker takes it.

労働基準法施行規則 art.19の2: the agreement fixes the hours (overtime hours beyond 60 in the month × the 25% difference between the 50% and 25% rates), the half-day or day unit, and a period from the day after that month ends within two months; art.19の2(3) gives four overtime hours for each hour of leave for which the 50% premium is not paid.

SUBSTITUTE_LEAVE_FOR_OVERTIME.description: Time off in lieu of overtime. Paid as a normal day (paid_share 1).

所得税法
references.quote: At the last salary payment of the year (a pay day in December, or the exit month of a leaver who dies, leaves in December or departs abroad, or the month of a departure abroad) the employer settles the year's tax of a resident who filed the 扶養控除等申告書 and earned 20,000,000 or less. 令和8年分 tables (令和8年度税制改正, in force 1 December 2026): 給与所得控除 at least 740,000 (本則 690,000 + 特例 50,000, 措置法 art.29の4; under 741,000 no salary income, and 1,451,000/1,453,000/1,456,000 from 2,191,000 to 2,199,999), 基礎控除 1,040,000 at 4,890,000 or less, 670,000 to 6,550,000, 620,000 to 23,500,000 (所得税法 art.86 with 措置法 art.41の16の2). Tax: the 速算表 on the taxable income (1,000 yen down) less the housing loan credit, times 102.1%, 100 yen down; the adjustment is that annual tax less the year's withholding (a refund when negative). Computed on a December pay day and at a qualifying exit (年末調整のしかた 令和8年分 pp.5-6: departure abroad, or no further salary expected after a disability exit or with the year's pay at most the row's limit). Year figures read the balance, each scheme apart, so resident tax stays out. YEAR_END_REFUND returns an over-withholding.
